Briefly toast the pepper paste and pul biber and stir in a splash of cooking water.
Mix in the lentils and noodles and serve sprinkled with parsley.

title: Air Fryer Patlıcan Kızartması (Aubergine Slices with Garlic Yoghurt and Tomato Sauce)
instructions: Cut the aubergine into 1 cm thick slices, salt, leave for 10 minutes and pat dry.
Brush with 6 g oil and air-fry at 200 °C for 14 minutes until golden brown, turning halfway.
Reduce the passata with the remaining oil, half of the garlic and salt for 5 minutes.
Stir the yoghurt with the remaining garlic and serve the aubergines with both sauces, parsley and flatbread.

title: Air Fryer Patates Köftesi (Potato and Bulgur Köfte) with Yoghurt Dip
instructions: Boil the potatoes, drain and mash finely. Soak the bulgur in 50 ml hot water for 10 minutes.
Knead the potatoes with the bulgur, egg, spring onion, parsley, kaşar and spices and shape into 8 oblong köfte.
Brush with oil and air-fry at 200 °C for 14 minutes until golden brown.
Serve with yoghurt as a dip.

title: Ayvalık Tostu (Vegetarian Cheese Toastie with Tomato, Pickled Gherkin and Pepper)
ingredients: Wholegrain toast roll or sandwich bread
instructions: Cut open the bread and cover one half with kaşar.
Top with tomato slices, gherkin slices and pepper rings and place the other half on top.
Toast in a sandwich press or in a weighted-down pan for 5 minutes until the cheese melts.
Spread the inside with yoghurt and serve with fresh cucumber.

title: Fırın Makarna (Baked Pasta with Béchamel and Kaşar)
instructions: Cook the pasta in salted water for 2 minutes less than stated and drain.
Melt the butter, sweat the flour, stir in the milk and simmer for 4 minutes into a béchamel, season with salt, pepper and nutmeg.
Leave to cool slightly, stir in the egg and half of the cheese and mix with the pasta.
Transfer to a small dish, sprinkle with the remaining cheese and bake at 200 °C for 20 minutes until golden brown. Serve with tomato slices.

title: Ayran (Turkish Yoghurt Drink) with Mint and Cucumber Sticks
instructions: Put the yoghurt, cold water and a pinch of salt into a blender or tall beaker.
Blend or whisk vigorously for 30 seconds until frothy.
Pour into a glass, garnish with mint leaves and serve with cucumber sticks.

title: Aşure (Noah's Pudding with Wheat, Pulses and Dried Fruit)
instructions: Soak the wheat overnight and cook in the water for 60 minutes until soft.
Add the chickpeas, beans, diced apricots and figs, raisins and sugar and simmer for 20 minutes while stirring until thick.
Pour into small bowls and leave to cool.
Sprinkle with walnuts, pomegranate seeds and cinnamon.

title: Revani Light (Semolina Yoghurt Cake with Lemon Syrup and Pistachios)
instructions: Whisk the egg with 8 g sugar until fluffy and stir in the yoghurt and oil.
Fold in the semolina, flour and baking powder and pour into a small greased tin (approx. 10 cm).
Bake at 180 °C for 25 minutes until golden brown.
Boil the remaining sugar with the lemon juice and 30 ml water for 3 minutes into a syrup and pour over the hot cake.
Leave to cool and sprinkle with chopped pistachios.

title: Keşkül (Almond Milk Pudding with Pistachios)
instructions: Heat the milk, almonds and sugar in a pan.
Stir the cornflour with the egg yolk and a little cold milk until smooth and stir into the hot milk.
Simmer for 5 minutes, stirring constantly, until the pudding is thick.
Pour into a small bowl, leave to cool and sprinkle with chopped pistachios.

title: Ayva Tatlısı (Braised Quince with Skyr and Walnuts)
instructions: Peel and halve the quince and remove the core, keeping the peel and seeds.
Place the quince half cut side up in a small pan, sprinkle with sugar, add the cloves, lemon juice, peel and seeds and pour in 150 ml water.
Cover and braise over low heat for 50 minutes until the quince is soft and ruby red, basting with the syrup.
Leave to cool and serve with skyr and walnuts.

title: Kayısı Tatlısı (Poached Apricots Filled with Skyr and Pistachios)
instructions: Bring the apricots to the boil with the sugar, lemon juice and 200 ml water and simmer for 20 minutes until soft and the syrup thickens slightly.
Leave to cool in the syrup.
Slit the apricots open on one side and fill with skyr.
Sprinkle with chopped pistachios and serve with a little syrup.

title: İncir Uyutması (Fig and Milk Dessert with Walnuts)
instructions: Cut the figs into small pieces and blend finely with a little milk.
Warm the remaining milk to about 40 °C, i.e. comfortably hand-warm.
Add the milk to the figs while stirring, pour into small bowls and leave covered in a warm place for 6 to 8 hours until the mixture sets like a pudding.
Chill and serve with walnuts and cinnamon.

title: Fıstıklı Dondurma Light (Pistachio Frozen Yoghurt)
instructions: Finely grind the pistachios and set aside 5 g for sprinkling.
Stir the yoghurt, milk, honey, vanilla and ground pistachios until smooth.
Pour into a shallow container and freeze for 3 hours, stirring vigorously every half hour.
Leave to soften for 10 minutes before serving and sprinkle with the remaining pistachios.

title: Tahinli Kurabiye (Vegan Tahini Cookies with Sesame) with Apple Wedges
instructions: Beat the tahini, sugar and oil until creamy.
Knead in the flour, baking powder and cinnamon until a soft, non-sticky dough forms.
Shape into 3 balls, flatten slightly, press a pattern in with a fork and sprinkle with sesame seeds.
Bake at 180 °C for 12 minutes, leave to cool on a rack and serve with apple wedges.

title: Aloo Paratha – Indian Potato-Stuffed Flatbread with Cucumber Raita
instructions: Knead the flour, water and salt into a soft dough and leave to rest for 15 minutes.
Boil the potatoes, mash finely and mix with coriander, chilli, cumin, garam masala and salt.
Divide the dough into 2 balls, enclose a portion of potato in each and carefully roll out into rounds.
Cook the parathas in a hot pan for 2 minutes per side and brush with ghee.
Stir the yoghurt with grated cucumber and salt to make raita and serve alongside.

title: Upma – South Indian Semolina with Vegetables, Mustard Seeds and Cashews
ingredients: Curry leaves, ginger, green chilli, turmeric, salt
instructions: Toast the semolina in a dry pan for 3 minutes until pale golden and set aside.
Heat the oil, toast the mustard seeds, cashews and curry leaves until the seeds pop, then sweat the onion, ginger and chilli for 3 minutes.
Add the carrot and peas, top up with water, season with salt and bring to the boil.
Sprinkle in the semolina while stirring and leave to swell for 3 minutes until fluffy. Serve with lemon juice.

title: Cachapas – Venezuelan Sweetcorn Pancakes with Queso Fresco and Avocado
instructions: Blend the sweetcorn coarsely with the milk, salt and a pinch of sugar and stir in the cornmeal.
Leave the mixture to swell for 5 minutes.
Fry two thick pancakes in the oil over medium heat for 3 minutes per side until golden brown.
Fill with crumbled cheese, fold over and serve with avocado slices.

title: Buckwheat Galette with Egg, Spinach and Mountain Cheese
instructions: Whisk the buckwheat flour with the water and salt until smooth and leave to rest for 15 minutes.
Slice the mushrooms and sauté briefly with the spinach in a pan.
Cook a thin galette in a large non-stick pan with half of the butter and flip it.
Place the cheese, mushrooms and spinach in the centre, crack the egg on top and fold the edges in to form a square.
Cover and cook for 3 minutes until the egg white has set, then brush with the remaining butter.

title: Fanqie Chao Dan – Chinese Tomato and Egg Stir-Fry with Rice
instructions: Cook the rice according to the packet instructions.
Whisk the eggs with salt, let them set into large soft curds in half of the oil in a hot pan and remove.
Cut the tomatoes into wedges and fry in the remaining oil for 3 minutes until juicy, then add the sugar and salt.
Return the eggs to the pan, toss briefly and serve over the rice with spring onions.

title: Okonomiyaki – Japanese Cabbage Pancake with Yoghurt-Mustard Sauce
instructions: Whisk the flour with the eggs and stock until smooth.
Finely shred the white cabbage and fold into the batter with the spring onions and a little ginger.
Shape the mixture into a thick pancake in the oil in a pan and cook covered over medium heat for 6 minutes per side.
Stir the yoghurt with the mustard and drizzle it over the pancake in a crisscross pattern with the soy sauce, then sprinkle with nori.

title: Mirza Ghasemi – Persian Smoky Aubergines with Tomato, Egg and Flatbread
instructions: Char the aubergines all over on a gas flame or under the grill, peel and chop finely.
Fry the garlic in the oil until golden, add the turmeric and diced tomatoes and reduce for 5 minutes.
Stir in the aubergines and braise for 5 minutes, then season with salt and pepper.
Whisk the eggs, fold into the mixture and let them set for 2 minutes while stirring. Serve with flatbread.

title: Dakos – Cretan Bread Salad with Tomato, Feta, Olives and Capers
ingredients: Wholegrain bread (toasted, instead of barley rusks)
instructions: Toast the bread until very crisp in a dry pan or the oven and sprinkle with a few drops of water.
Grate the tomatoes on a coarse grater, salt and leave to drain.
Cover the bread with the tomato pulp, crumble the feta over and top with olives and capers.
Drizzle with olive oil and sprinkle with oregano.

title: Masala Omelette with Tomato, Onion, Coriander and Wholegrain Toast
ingredients: Green chilli, turmeric, garam masala, salt
instructions: Finely chop the tomato, onion, chilli and coriander.
Whisk the eggs with the turmeric, garam masala and salt and stir in the vegetables.
Spread the mixture in the hot oil in a pan and let it set over medium heat for 3 minutes, then flip and fry for 1 more minute.
Serve with toasted wholegrain bread.

title: Beetroot and Cherry Smoothie with Ginger and Oat Drink
instructions: Cut the beetroot into pieces and peel the ginger.
Blend all the ingredients for 1 minute until completely smooth.
Pour into a large glass and drink immediately.

title: Papaya and Lime Smoothie with Soy Yoghurt, Banana and Linseed
instructions: Deseed the papaya and scoop out the flesh.
Blend with the banana, soy yoghurt, lime juice, linseed and water for 1 minute until creamy.
Pour into a glass and enjoy immediately.

title: PB&J Smoothie with Strawberries, Peanut Butter, Banana and Skyr
instructions: Put all the ingredients into the blender.
Blend on the highest setting for 1 minute until the smoothie is thick and creamy.
Pour into a glass and serve with a dollop of peanut butter.

title: Pumpkin Spice Smoothie with Pumpkin, Skyr and Oats
instructions: Steam the pumpkin pieces for 10 minutes until soft and leave to cool.
Blend with all the other ingredients for 1 minute until smooth.
Pour into a glass and dust with a little cinnamon.

title: Pasta alla Norma – Sicilian Wholegrain Pasta with Aubergine and Ricotta
instructions: Dice the aubergine, toss with 7 g oil and roast in the oven at 220 °C for 20 minutes until golden brown.
Sweat the garlic in the remaining oil, add the passata and simmer for 10 minutes.
Cook the pasta in salted water until al dente.
Toss the pasta and aubergines with the sauce and serve with ricotta and basil.

title: Spinach and Ricotta Gnudi with Tomato Sauce and Vegetarian Hard Cheese
instructions: Blanch the spinach, squeeze out very well and chop finely.
Stir with the ricotta, egg, half of the cheese, flour, nutmeg and salt into a soft dough and shape into walnut-sized balls with floured hands.
Poach the gnudi in simmering salted water for 4 minutes until they rise.
Simmer the passata with oil and sage for 5 minutes and serve the gnudi with the sauce and remaining cheese.

title: Vegetable and Lentil Lasagne with Wholegrain Sheets
instructions: Finely dice the courgette and carrot and fry in the oil for 4 minutes.
Add the lentils, passata and 100 ml water and simmer for 12 minutes into a thick sauce, seasoning with oregano, salt and pepper.
Bring the milk to the boil with the cornflour, salt and nutmeg while stirring until it thickens.
Layer the sheets, lentil sauce and white sauce in a small dish and finish with mozzarella.
Bake at 190 °C for 35 minutes and leave to rest for 5 minutes before cutting.

title: Air Fryer Melanzane alla Parmigiana Light
instructions: Cut the aubergine lengthwise into 1 cm thick slices, brush with oil and air-fry at 200 °C for 12 minutes until golden brown.
Reduce the passata with salt and basil for 5 minutes.
Layer the aubergines, sauce and mozzarella in a small ovenproof dish and finish with the hard cheese.
Bake in the air fryer at 180 °C for 10 minutes and serve with bread.

title: Leek Quiche Light with Quark-Oil Pastry and Mountain Cheese
instructions: Knead the flour, quark, oil, a pinch of baking powder and salt into a smooth dough and line a small tart tin (approx. 16 cm) with it.
Slice the leek into fine rings and sweat in a pan for 5 minutes.
Whisk the eggs with the milk, cheese, nutmeg, salt and pepper.
Spread the leek over the pastry, pour the egg mixture over and bake at 190 °C for 30 minutes until golden brown.

title: Air Fryer Patatas Bravas with Spicy Tomato Sauce and Yoghurt Aioli
instructions: Cut the potatoes into 2 cm cubes and toss with 6 g oil, salt and half of the paprika.
Air-fry at 200 °C for 20 minutes until crispy, shaking in between.
Reduce the passata with the remaining oil, paprika and chilli for 5 minutes. Stir the yoghurt with garlic and salt.
Drizzle the potatoes with both sauces and serve immediately.

title: Gazpacho Andaluz with Chickpea Croutons
instructions: Roughly chop the tomatoes, cucumber, pepper, onion and garlic and blend very finely with the bread, vinegar, 8 g oil and salt.
Chill for at least 1 hour.
Pat the chickpeas dry, toss with the remaining oil and paprika and roast in a pan for 8 minutes until crispy.
Pour the gazpacho into bowls and serve with the chickpeas and a little diced cucumber.

title: Lecsó – Hungarian Pepper and Tomato Stew with Egg and Wholegrain Bread
instructions: Slice the onion into strips and sweat in the oil for 5 minutes until translucent.
Slice the peppers into rings, add and braise for 8 minutes, then stir in the paprika.
Add the diced tomatoes and reduce for 8 minutes, seasoning with salt and pepper.
Whisk the eggs, fold in and let them set for 2 minutes. Serve with bread.

title: Paprikás Krumpli – Hungarian Paprika Potato Stew with Soy Yoghurt
instructions: Dice the onion and sweat in the oil for 5 minutes until golden.
Take the pot off the heat and stir in the paprika and caraway.
Add the diced potatoes, pepper, tomato and stock and simmer for 20 minutes until the potatoes are soft and the sauce is thick.
Season with marjoram and salt and serve with soy yoghurt.

title: Pierogi Ruskie – Polish Dumplings with Potato-Quark Filling and Fried Onions
instructions: Knead the flour, warm water and salt into a supple dough and leave to rest for 20 minutes.
Boil and mash the potatoes. Dice the onion and fry in half of the oil until golden brown, then mix half of it with the potatoes, quark, salt and pepper.
Roll the dough out thinly, cut out circles, fill, fold into half moons and press the edges firmly together.
Boil the pierogi in salted water for 4 minutes until they rise and fry briefly in the remaining oil.
Serve with the remaining fried onions and yoghurt.

title: Tyrolean Spinach Dumplings with Mountain Cheese and Tomato Salad
instructions: Pour warm milk over the dumpling bread and leave to soak for 10 minutes.
Blanch the spinach, squeeze out well and chop finely. Dice the onion and sweat in the butter until translucent.
Knead the bread with the spinach, onion, egg, 15 g cheese, nutmeg and salt and shape 4 dumplings with wet hands.
Let the dumplings steep in gently simmering salted water for 15 minutes.
Sprinkle with the remaining cheese and chives and serve with tomato salad.

title: Mushroom Goulash with Bread Dumplings
ingredients: Button mushrooms and king oyster mushrooms
instructions: Pour warm milk over the dumpling bread, leave to soak for 10 minutes, knead with the egg, parsley and salt and shape into 2 dumplings.
Let the dumplings steep in simmering salted water for 15 minutes.
Fry the onion in the oil until golden brown, add the mushrooms in large pieces and sear for 6 minutes.
Briefly toast the paprika and tomato paste, deglaze with stock and simmer for 10 minutes until thick, seasoning with caraway, marjoram, salt and pepper.
Serve the goulash with the dumplings.

title: Swabian Lentils with Spaetzle (Vegetarian)
instructions: Finely dice the onion, carrot and celeriac, sweat in the oil for 4 minutes and dust with flour.
Add the lentils, bay leaf and stock and simmer for 30 minutes until the lentils are soft.
Season boldly with vinegar, salt and pepper.
Warm the spaetzle in a pan and serve with the lentils.

title: White Asparagus with Herb Scrambled Eggs and Boiled Potatoes
instructions: Boil the potatoes in their skins for 20 minutes and peel.
Peel the asparagus and cook in salted water with a pinch of sugar and a little lemon juice for 12 minutes.
Whisk the eggs with the milk, herbs and salt and let them set creamily in the butter over low heat.
Arrange the asparagus with the scrambled eggs and potatoes.

title: Frankfurt Green Sauce with Eggs and Boiled Potatoes
instructions: Peel the potatoes and boil in salted water for 20 minutes. Hard-boil the eggs for 9 minutes.
Wash the herbs, spin dry and chop very finely or blend with a little yoghurt.
Stir the herbs with the yoghurt, sour cream, mustard, lemon juice, salt and pepper and leave to infuse for 10 minutes.
Halve the eggs and arrange with the potatoes and green sauce.

title: Welsh Rarebit – Grilled Cheese Toast with Mustard and Tomato Salad
instructions: Stir the milk with the flour in a small pan until smooth and bring to the boil while stirring.
Take the pan off the heat and stir in the cheese, mustard, paprika and pepper until a thick cream forms.
Toast the bread lightly, spread with the cheese cream and grill under the oven grill for 3 minutes until golden brown.
Serve with tomatoes and rocket.

title: Cauliflower Cheese – British Cauliflower Cheese Bake with Peas
instructions: Divide the cauliflower into florets and parboil in salted water for 6 minutes, cooking the peas briefly with it.
Bring the milk to the boil with the cornflour, mustard, nutmeg and salt while stirring until the sauce thickens and stir in 25 g cheese.
Put the vegetables into a baking dish, pour over the sauce and sprinkle with the remaining cheese.
Bake at 200 °C for 20 minutes until golden brown and serve with bread.

title: Swedish Yellow Split Pea Soup with Mustard and Crispbread
instructions: Soak the peas overnight, drain and bring to the boil with the stock, diced onion and carrot.
Cover and simmer gently for 60 minutes until the peas fall apart, stirring occasionally.
Season with marjoram, thyme and salt.
Serve with a dollop of mustard and crispbread.

title: Maqluba – Upside-Down Rice with Aubergine, Cauliflower and Chickpeas
instructions: Slice the aubergine and divide the cauliflower into florets, toss with 10 g oil and roast in the oven at 220 °C for 20 minutes.
Line a small pot with tomato slices and layer the aubergines, cauliflower, chickpeas and washed rice.
Bring the stock to the boil with baharat, turmeric and salt, pour in and cook covered over low heat for 25 minutes.
Leave to rest for 10 minutes and turn the pot out onto a plate. Sprinkle with almonds toasted in the remaining oil.

title: Ash Reshteh – Persian Herb, Bean and Noodle Soup with Yoghurt and Fried Onions
instructions: Pre-cook the lentils in the stock for 15 minutes, then add the beans and chickpeas.
Add the chopped herbs and spinach and simmer for 10 minutes, then cook the broken noodles in it for 10 minutes.
Fry the onion rings in the oil until golden brown and stir half of them into the soup with the turmeric.
Garnish the soup with yoghurt, the remaining fried onions and mint warmed in a little oil.

title: Fesenjan with Aubergine and Chickpeas – Walnut and Pomegranate Stew with Rice
instructions: Toast the walnuts in a dry pot for 4 minutes, add 250 ml water and simmer covered for 30 minutes until a little oil separates.
Fry the onion in the oil until golden brown, add the diced aubergine and fry for 8 minutes.
Add the aubergine, chickpeas, pomegranate molasses, cinnamon and turmeric to the walnut sauce, reduce for 15 minutes until thick and season with salt.
Cook the rice and serve with the fesenjan and pomegranate seeds.

title: Baingan Bharta – Smoky Aubergine Curry with Peas and Wholewheat Chapati
ingredients: Ginger, garlic, garam masala, cumin, salt
instructions: Char the aubergines all over on a gas flame or in the oven at 230 °C, peel and mash roughly.
Fry the onion in the oil until golden brown and toast the ginger, garlic and cumin for 1 minute.
Add the diced tomatoes and peas and simmer for 6 minutes, then stir in the aubergine and garam masala and braise for 5 minutes.
Knead the flour with a little water and salt, roll out 2 thin chapatis and cook in a hot pan for 1 minute per side.
Serve the bharta with the chapatis.

title: Malai Kofta Light – Paneer and Potato Balls in Tomato-Cashew Sauce with Rice
instructions: Boil and mash the potatoes, knead with grated paneer, cornflour and salt and shape into 6 balls.
Brush the balls with 4 g oil and bake in the oven at 200 °C for 18 minutes until golden brown.
Sweat the onion in the remaining oil, briefly toast the ginger and spices, add the tomatoes and cashews and simmer for 8 minutes, then blend finely and stir in the yoghurt.
Cook the rice and serve the kofta in the sauce with rice.

title: Kadhi Pakora – Yoghurt and Gram Flour Curry with Onion Pakoras and Rice
instructions: Stir the yoghurt with 20 g gram flour, turmeric, salt and water until smooth and simmer gently for 20 minutes while stirring.
Mix the remaining flour with finely sliced onion, chilli, salt and a little water into a thick batter, shape small pakoras and bake with 6 g oil in the oven at 220 °C for 15 minutes until crispy.
Toast the mustard seeds, cumin and fenugreek in the remaining oil and pour over the kadhi.
Place the pakoras in the kadhi and serve with rice.

title: Bhindi Masala – Okra Curry with Tomatoes and Basmati Rice
instructions: Wash the okra, pat very dry and cut into 2 cm pieces.
Fry the okra in 6 g oil over high heat for 8 minutes until no longer slimy and remove.
Fry the onion in the remaining oil until golden brown, add the spices and diced tomatoes and reduce for 5 minutes.
Mix in the okra and chickpeas, finish cooking for 4 minutes and serve with rice.

title: Pav Bhaji – Spiced Vegetable Mash with Wholegrain Rolls
ingredients: Pav bhaji masala, ginger, garlic, coriander, salt
instructions: Boil the potatoes, cauliflower and peas in salted water for 15 minutes until soft and drain.
Fry the onion and pepper in 5 g butter for 5 minutes, add the ginger, garlic, masala and diced tomatoes and reduce for 5 minutes.
Add the cooked vegetables, mash into a coarse, thick purée and simmer with a little water for 5 minutes.
Halve the roll, toast in the remaining butter and serve with the bhaji, coriander, raw onion and lemon.

title: Vegetable Biryani with Cucumber Raita
instructions: Wash the rice and parboil in salted water for 7 minutes, then drain.
Fry the onion rings in the ghee until golden brown, add the vegetables, masala and 50 g yoghurt and braise for 8 minutes.
Layer the vegetables and rice in a pot, top with saffron water, mint and the fried onions and cook covered over the lowest heat for 20 minutes.
Stir the remaining yoghurt with grated cucumber and salt and serve with the toasted cashews and the biryani.

title: Moong Dal Khichdi with Vegetables and Coriander
instructions: Wash the rice and dal together and soak for 15 minutes.
Toast the cumin in the oil and sweat the ginger, carrot and turmeric for 2 minutes.
Add the rice, dal, peas and water, cover and cook for 20 minutes until soft and porridge-like.
Stir in the spinach, season with salt and serve with coriander.

title: Dhokla – Steamed Gram Flour Cake with Coriander Chutney
ingredients: Baking powder, turmeric, ginger, green chilli, salt
instructions: Stir the gram flour with the soy yoghurt, water, turmeric, ginger and salt until smooth and leave to rest for 10 minutes.
Stir in the baking powder and half of the lemon juice, pour into a greased dish and steam in a steamer basket for 15 minutes.
Toast the mustard seeds and chilli in the oil, pour over the cake and cut into squares.
Blend the coriander and mint with the remaining lemon juice, salt and a little water into a chutney and serve alongside.

title: Vegan Mapo Tofu with Shiitake and Jasmine Rice
instructions: Cook the rice according to the packet instructions. Cut the tofu into 2 cm cubes and let it steep in lightly salted water for 2 minutes.
Finely chop the shiitake and fry in the oil for 4 minutes until browned, then toast the doubanjiang, garlic and ginger for 1 minute.
Add the stock and soy sauce, gently add the tofu and simmer for 5 minutes.
Thicken with the mixed cornflour, sprinkle with ground Sichuan pepper and spring onions and serve with rice.

title: Jiaozi with Tofu and Napa Cabbage Filling and Soy-Vinegar Dip
instructions: Knead the flour with the water into a smooth dough and leave to rest covered for 20 minutes.
Finely chop the napa cabbage, salt it, leave for 10 minutes and squeeze out firmly. Mix with the crumbled tofu, chopped shiitake, spring onions, ginger and sesame oil.
Shape the dough into a roll, divide into 14 pieces, roll out into thin circles, fill and seal into pleated half moons.
Boil the jiaozi in simmering water for 5 minutes until they rise.
Stir the soy sauce with the rice vinegar and serve as a dip.

title: Pad Kra Pao Tofu – Thai Basil Tofu with Fried Egg and Jasmine Rice
instructions: Cook the rice according to the packet instructions. Crumble the tofu roughly by hand.
Toast the garlic and chilli in 5 g oil in the wok for 30 seconds, add the tofu and fry vigorously for 5 minutes.
Add the beans in short pieces, stir-fry with the soy sauce, mushroom sauce and a pinch of sugar for 3 minutes and fold in the basil.
Fry the egg crispy in the remaining oil and serve with the tofu and rice.

title: Yaki Udon with Vegetables, Tofu and Sesame
instructions: Cook the udon according to the packet instructions and rinse under cold water.
Dice the tofu and fry in half of the oil in the wok for 5 minutes until golden brown, then remove.
Stir-fry the cabbage, carrot and mushrooms in strips in the remaining oil with ginger for 4 minutes.
Add the noodles, tofu, soy sauce and a pinch of sugar, toss for 2 minutes and sprinkle with spring onions and sesame seeds.

title: Di San Xian with Edamame – Wok-Fried Aubergine, Potato and Pepper
instructions: Cut the potato and aubergine into bite-sized pieces, toss with 8 g oil and air-fry at 200 °C for 15 minutes until golden brown.
Toast the garlic in the remaining oil in the wok and stir-fry the pepper and edamame for 3 minutes.
Add the potatoes and aubergine.
Stir the stock with the soy sauce, cornflour and a pinch of sugar, pour in and reduce for 1 minute until glossy.

title: Pai Huang Gua – Chinese Smashed Cucumber Salad with Edamame and Garlic
instructions: Cook the edamame in salted water for 4 minutes and refresh in cold water.
Press the cucumber with the flat side of a knife, break into rough pieces, salt and leave for 5 minutes, then drain.
Finely chop the garlic and stir with the vinegar, soy sauce, sesame oil, sugar and chilli.
Mix the cucumber and edamame with the dressing and sprinkle with sesame seeds.

title: Bánh Xèo – Vietnamese Rice Flour Crêpes with Tofu, Sprouts and Herbs
instructions: Stir the rice flour with the coconut milk, water, turmeric, salt and spring onions into a thin batter and leave to rest for 10 minutes.
Cut the tofu into strips and fry with the mushrooms in 4 g oil for 5 minutes.
Spread the remaining oil in a hot pan, pour in half of the batter thinly, put the tofu, mushrooms and sprouts on one half and cook covered for 3 minutes until crispy.
Fold the crêpe over and repeat with the second half of the batter.
Stir the soy sauce with the lime juice and chilli and serve the crêpes in lettuce leaves with herbs and the dip.

title: Dubu Jorim – Korean Braised Tofu with Rice and Spinach Namul
instructions: Cook the rice according to the packet instructions. Cut the tofu into 1 cm thick slices and pat dry.
Fry the tofu in the oil for 3 minutes per side until golden brown.
Stir the soy sauce, water, chilli, garlic and a pinch of sugar, pour over the tofu and reduce for 5 minutes until glazed.
Blanch the spinach briefly, squeeze out and dress with sesame oil, sesame seeds and salt. Serve the tofu with spring onions, rice and namul.

title: Hiyayakko – Chilled Silken Tofu with Ginger, Spring Onion and Edamame
instructions: Cook the edamame in salted water for 4 minutes and refresh in cold water.
Carefully remove the silken tofu from the pack, drain and divide into two blocks in a deep plate.
Top with ginger, spring onions, nori and sesame seeds and place the edamame alongside.
Stir the soy sauce with the sesame oil and drizzle over just before serving.

title: Vegetarian Nasi Lemak – Coconut Rice with Egg, Peanuts, Cucumber and Tempeh Sambal
ingredients: Pandan leaf or lemongrass, sugar, salt
instructions: Bring the rice to the boil with the coconut milk, 60 ml water, salt and pandan, cover and cook for 15 minutes.
Boil the egg for 7 minutes, refresh in cold water and halve.
Dice the tempeh and fry in the oil for 5 minutes until crispy, add the onion, sambal and a pinch of sugar and reduce for 3 minutes into a thick sambal.
Arrange the coconut rice with the tempeh sambal, egg, peanuts and cucumber slices.

title: Pad See Ew Tofu – Stir-Fried Wide Rice Noodles with Broccoli and Egg
instructions: Soak the rice noodles in warm water for 10 minutes and drain.
Dice the tofu and fry in half of the oil in the wok until golden brown, fry the broccoli and garlic for 3 minutes and push everything to the side.
Crack the egg into the centre, let it set briefly and break it up.
Add the noodles, remaining oil, soy sauce and a pinch of sugar and fry over high heat for 3 minutes until the noodles caramelise slightly. Serve with pepper.

title: Bún Chay – Vietnamese Rice Noodle Salad with Lemongrass Tofu and Herbs
instructions: Steep the vermicelli in boiling water for 4 minutes, rinse under cold water and drain.
Slice the tofu, mix with finely chopped lemongrass and garlic and fry in the oil for 3 minutes per side until golden brown.
Stir the soy sauce with the lime juice, 2 tbsp water, sugar and chilli into a dressing.
Place the noodles on the lettuce, cucumber, carrot and herbs, top with tofu, sprinkle with peanuts and serve with the dressing.

title: Ginataang Gulay – Filipino Squash and Bean Vegetables in Coconut Milk with Rice
instructions: Cook the rice according to the packet instructions.
Sweat the onion, garlic and ginger in the oil for 3 minutes and fry the tofu cubes for 3 minutes.
Add the diced squash and coconut milk and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the beans in pieces and cook for another 6 minutes, season with soy sauce and salt and serve with rice.

title: Kottu Roti – Sri Lankan Chopped Flatbread Stir-Fry with Vegetables and Egg
ingredients: Curry powder, chilli, curry leaves, salt
instructions: Cut the flatbreads into thin strips.
Cut the cabbage, carrot and leek into strips and fry in the oil with curry leaves and curry powder over high heat for 5 minutes.
Add the eggs and let them set while stirring.
Add the bread strips and chop and mix everything with two spatulas for 3 minutes, then season with chilli and salt.

title: Ndengu – Kenyan Mung Bean Curry with Wholewheat Chapati
instructions: Boil the mung beans in plenty of water for 30 minutes until soft and drain.
Fry the onion in 5 g oil until golden, toast the garlic and spices for 1 minute, add the tomatoes and reduce for 5 minutes.
Add the beans and coconut milk and simmer for 8 minutes until creamy, then season with salt and coriander.
Knead the flour with water, salt and the remaining oil into a soft dough, roll out 2 thin chapatis and cook in a hot pan for 1 minute per side.

title: Lentil and Mushroom Bourguignon with Mashed Potatoes
ingredients: Thyme, bay leaf, salt, pepper, nutmeg
instructions: Halve the mushrooms and sear in the oil for 6 minutes, then fry the shallots and carrot slices for 3 minutes.
Briefly toast the tomato paste, deglaze with the alcohol-free red wine and reduce a little.
Add the lentils, stock, thyme and bay leaf, cover and braise for 30 minutes until the lentils are soft and the sauce is thick.
Boil the potatoes, mash with warm milk, salt and nutmeg and serve with the bourguignon.

title: Vegetable Pot Pie with a Filo Lid
instructions: Dice the potato and carrot and fry with the mushrooms in a pan with 3 g butter for 6 minutes.
Stir the milk with the cornflour, pour in and bring to the boil while stirring until the sauce thickens. Stir in the peas, beans, thyme, salt and pepper.
Put the filling into an ovenproof dish, loosely crumple the filo sheets on top and brush with the remaining melted butter.
Bake at 200 °C for 20 minutes until the lid is golden brown and crisp.

title: Khachapuri Adjaruli Light – Georgian Cheese Bread Boat with Egg
instructions: Knead the flour with the water, yeast, salt and a pinch of sugar into a soft dough and leave to rise for 40 minutes.
Roll the dough into an oval, roll in the long sides and twist the ends together into a boat.
Fill with grated mozzarella and crumbled feta and bake at 230 °C for 12 minutes.
Place the egg yolk in the centre, bake for another 2 minutes and serve with the butter.

title: Papa a la Huancaína – Peruvian Potatoes with Cheese-Chilli Sauce and Egg
instructions: Boil the potatoes in salted water for 20 minutes, peel and slice. Hard-boil the egg for 9 minutes.
Blend the pepper, cheese, milk, crackers, chilli and garlic into a smooth yellow sauce and season with salt.
Arrange the potatoes on lettuce leaves and pour the sauce over them.
Garnish with egg quarters and olives.

title: Sopa de Fideo – Mexican Tomato Noodle Soup with Beans and Avocado
instructions: Toast the vermicelli in the oil for 3 minutes while stirring until golden brown.
Add the chopped onion and garlic and sweat for 2 minutes.
Add the passata, stock, cumin and beans and simmer for 8 minutes until the noodles are soft.
Serve with diced avocado, crumbled cheese, coriander and lime.

title: Sopa de Quinua – Andean Quinoa Vegetable Soup with Cheese
instructions: Wash the quinoa thoroughly.
Sweat the onion in the oil until translucent and fry the carrot, diced potato and cumin for 2 minutes.
Add the stock and quinoa and simmer for 15 minutes, then cook the peas for 5 minutes.
Season with oregano and salt and serve with crumbled cheese and coriander.

title: Locro de Papa – Ecuadorian Potato and Cheese Soup with Avocado
instructions: Sweat the onion in the oil with the cumin and achiote for 3 minutes.
Add the diced potatoes and stock and simmer for 20 minutes, then mash a third of the potatoes.
Add the milk, heat through and stir in 30 g cheese, then season with salt.
Serve with avocado slices and the remaining cheese.

title: Causa Limeña – Peruvian Potato-Lime Stack with Avocado and Egg
ingredients: Ají amarillo paste or turmeric and chilli, salt
instructions: Boil, peel and press the potatoes while still warm. Knead with the lime juice, oil, ají paste and salt into a smooth dough.
Roughly mash the chickpeas and mix with the yoghurt, chopped onion and salt. Hard-boil the egg for 9 minutes.
Press half of the potato mixture into a serving ring, layer in the chickpea cream and avocado slices and finish with the remaining potato mixture.
Lift off the ring and garnish with egg slices.

title: Sopa Negra – Costa Rican Black Bean Soup with Egg
instructions: Dice the onion, pepper and garlic and sweat in the oil for 5 minutes.
Add the beans, stock and cumin and simmer for 15 minutes, then blend a third of the soup and return it.
Boil the egg for 7 minutes, peel and halve.
Serve the soup with the egg and coriander.

title: Enchiladas with Sweet Potato and Bean Filling and Red Sauce
instructions: Dice the sweet potato and roast in the oven at 210 °C for 20 minutes until soft, then mash roughly with the beans, cumin and salt and mix in the chopped spinach.
Sweat the onion in the oil until translucent, add the passata, chipotle and oregano and simmer for 5 minutes.
Fill the tortillas, roll up and place in a dish, pour the sauce over and sprinkle with cheese.
Bake at 200 °C for 15 minutes and serve with yoghurt.

title: Tlayuda – Crispy Oaxacan Tortilla with Bean Purée, Cheese and Avocado
instructions: Blend the beans with cumin, garlic, salt and a little water into a smooth purée.
Toast the tortilla in a pan or the oven for 3 minutes until crispy.
Spread with the bean purée, sprinkle with mozzarella and grill for 3 minutes until the cheese melts.
Top with shredded cabbage, diced tomato, avocado, salsa and lime.

title: Couscous aux Sept Légumes – Moroccan Seven-Vegetable Couscous with Chickpeas
ingredients: Ras el hanout, turmeric, ginger, coriander, salt
instructions: Sweat the onion and tomato in the oil with ras el hanout, turmeric and ginger for 4 minutes.
Add the stock, carrot, swede and cabbage and simmer for 15 minutes, then cook the squash, courgette and chickpeas for 10 minutes.
Pour 90 ml hot stock from the pot over the couscous, leave to swell for 5 minutes and fluff up.
Mound the couscous, arrange the vegetables on top, drizzle with stock and sprinkle with coriander.

title: Lablabi – Tunisian Chickpea Soup with Egg, Cumin and Harissa
instructions: Simmer the chickpeas with the stock, garlic and cumin for 15 minutes.
Boil the egg for 6 minutes until soft and peel.
Place the bread in pieces in a deep bowl and pour the hot soup over it.
Break open the egg, add the harissa, olive oil, lemon juice and a pinch of cumin and stir everything together before eating.

title: Mechouia – Tunisian Grilled Vegetable Salad with Egg and Capers
instructions: Char the peppers, tomatoes and onion all over under the oven grill or on the grill and leave covered for 10 minutes.
Skin and deseed the vegetables and chop finely with the garlic.
Season with olive oil, caraway, coriander, lemon and salt.
Hard-boil the egg for 9 minutes and serve the salad with egg quarters, capers and bread.

title: Spaghetti Aglio, Olio e Peperoncino with Cherry Tomatoes, Rocket and White Beans
ingredients: Parsley, chilli flakes, lemon zest, salt
instructions: Cook the spaghetti in salted water until al dente and reserve a little pasta water.
Fry the sliced garlic in the oil over medium heat until pale golden and add the chilli flakes.
Toss the halved cherry tomatoes and beans in for 2 minutes, then mix in the pasta and a splash of pasta water.
Fold in the rocket and serve with parsley, lemon zest and hard cheese.

title: Pasta Primavera with Asparagus, Peas and Courgette
instructions: Cook the pasta in salted water until al dente and reserve 80 ml pasta water.
Cut the asparagus into pieces and the courgette into half moons and fry in the oil for 5 minutes, cooking the peas for 2 minutes.
Stir in the cream cheese with the pasta water until a light sauce forms.
Mix in the pasta, season with lemon, basil, salt and pepper and serve with hard cheese.

title: One-Pot Orzo with Tomatoes, Spinach and Feta
instructions: Sweat the garlic in the oil, add the orzo and toast for 1 minute.
Add the halved tomatoes, chickpeas and stock and simmer for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the liquid is almost absorbed.
Fold in the spinach and let it wilt.
Season with oregano and lemon and serve with crumbled feta.

title: High-Protein Lentil Pasta with Creamy Cottage Cheese and Tomato Sauce
instructions: Cook the lentil pasta according to the packet instructions until al dente.
Blend the cottage cheese with the passata, garlic, basil and salt until smooth.
Warm the sauce gently in the oil in a pan and let the spinach wilt, without boiling.
Mix in the pasta and serve with hard cheese and chilli.

title: Protein Bagel from Skyr Dough with Cream Cheese, Cucumber and Egg
instructions: Knead the flour with the skyr, a pinch of baking powder and salt into a smooth dough.
Divide the dough into 2 pieces, roll into ropes and close into rings, brush with a little beaten egg and sprinkle with sesame seeds.
Bake at 190 °C for 22 minutes until golden brown. Fry the remaining egg in a pan as a fried egg.
Halve the bagels, spread with cream cheese and top with cucumber slices, egg and chives.

title: Air Fryer Cottage Cheese Chips with Paprika and Vegetable Sticks
instructions: Drain the cottage cheese well and mash finely with a fork, then stir in the hard cheese and spices.
Place small mounds well spaced on baking paper in the air fryer basket and press flat.
Bake at 190 °C for 12 to 15 minutes until golden brown and crisp, then leave to cool on the paper.
Serve with vegetable sticks.

title: Air Fryer Arancini with a Pea-Mozzarella Centre and Tomato Sauce
instructions: Cook the rice with the stock and saffron for 18 minutes while stirring until creamy, stir in the hard cheese and leave to cool completely.
Divide the rice into 4 portions, enclose a cube of mozzarella and a few peas in each and shape into balls.
Roll the balls in beaten egg and panko, spray with oil and bake in the air fryer at 200 °C for 12 minutes until golden brown.
Simmer the passata with basil and salt for 5 minutes and serve as a dip.

title: Air Fryer Polenta Fries with Rosemary and Yoghurt Dip
instructions: Stir the polenta into boiling stock and cook for 5 minutes while stirring until thick, then stir in the hard cheese and chopped rosemary.
Spread the mixture 1 cm thick in a dish and leave to set for 1 hour.
Cut into sticks, brush with oil and bake in the air fryer at 200 °C for 15 minutes until crisp.
Stir the yoghurt with garlic and salt and serve as a dip.

title: Light Air Fryer Mozzarella Sticks with Marinara
instructions: Cut the mozzarella into 6 sticks and freeze for 30 minutes.
Roll the sticks one after another in flour, egg and oregano-seasoned panko, repeating egg and panko for a thicker crust.
Bake in the air fryer at 200 °C for 6 minutes until golden brown and the cheese is soft.
Simmer the passata with garlic, oregano and salt for 5 minutes and serve as a dip.

title: Air Fryer Rice Paper Spring Rolls with Tofu and Vegetables
instructions: Soak the glass noodles in hot water for 5 minutes and chop.
Crumble the tofu and mix with finely shredded cabbage, carrot, noodles, soy sauce, ginger and garlic.
Briefly dip the rice paper in water, add the filling, fold in the sides and roll up tightly.
Brush the rolls with oil and bake in the air fryer at 200 °C for 12 minutes until crisp, turning once. Serve with sweet chilli sauce.

title: Air Fryer Bean and Cheese Taquitos with Salsa
ingredients: Pinto beans or kidney beans (tinned, drained)
instructions: Roughly mash the beans with cumin, chilli and salt and mix in the cheese.
Briefly warm the tortillas in a pan so they become pliable, top with the filling and roll up tightly.
Place seam side down in the air fryer, brush with oil and bake at 200 °C for 8 minutes until crisp.
Chop the tomato with coriander, lime and salt into a salsa and serve with yoghurt alongside the taquitos.

title: Air Fryer Squash Wedges with Feta, Chickpeas and Honey-Thyme
instructions: Deseed the squash and cut into wedges, pat the chickpeas dry.
Mix both with oil, thyme, chilli and salt and roast in the air fryer at 200 °C for 18 minutes, shaking after 10 minutes.
Crumble the feta over the hot wedges and drizzle with honey.
Arrange on rocket and sprinkle with pumpkin seeds.

title: Pan con Tomate with Manchego, Egg and Olives
instructions: Boil the egg for 8 minutes, refresh in cold water and slice.
Toast the bread and rub with the halved garlic clove.
Grate the tomato, spread the pulp on the bread, drizzle with olive oil and season with salt.
Serve with cheese slices, egg and olives.

title: Fibermaxxing Wrap with Beans, Vegetables, Avocado and Flaxseed
instructions: Roughly mash the beans with cumin, lime juice and salt.
Finely grate the red cabbage and carrot.
Spread the wrap with hummus, top with beans, spinach, cabbage, carrot and avocado slices and sprinkle with flaxseed.
Roll up tightly, halve and serve.

title: Fibermaxxing Barley Soup with Beans, Kale and Vegetables
instructions: Dice the onion, carrot and celeriac and sweat in the oil for 5 minutes.
Add the barley, passata, stock, thyme and bay leaf and simmer for 30 minutes.
Add the beans and torn kale and cook for another 10 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper.

title: Frozen Yoghurt Bark with Berries, Pistachios and Dark Chocolate
instructions: Stir the yoghurt with honey and vanilla until smooth and spread about 1 cm thick on a board lined with baking paper.
Scatter the berries, chopped pistachios and shaved chocolate on top and press in lightly.
Freeze for at least 3 hours.
Break into irregular pieces and serve immediately.

title: Matcha Coconut Ice Lollies with Soy Yoghurt
instructions: Blend the coconut milk, soy yoghurt, matcha and maple syrup until smooth.
Pour into 3 ice lolly moulds, insert the sticks and freeze for at least 5 hours.
Briefly hold the moulds under warm water and release the lollies.
Serve sprinkled with desiccated coconut.

title: Air Fryer Churros with Cinnamon Sugar and Chocolate Dip
instructions: Bring the water to the boil with the butter and salt, add the flour all at once and stir until a smooth ball comes away from the bottom of the pan.
Fill the dough into a piping bag with a star nozzle and pipe 15 cm long strips onto baking paper in the air fryer.
Bake at 190 °C for 12 minutes until golden brown and immediately roll in sugar with cinnamon.
Warm the milk, melt the chocolate in it and serve as a dip.

title: Light Pavlova with Skyr Cream and Berries
instructions: Beat the egg whites until stiff, slowly sprinkle in the sugar and keep beating until glossy, then fold in the cornflour and a few drops of lemon juice.
Shape into 2 nests on baking paper and dry at 120 °C for 75 minutes, then leave to cool in the switched-off oven.
Stir the skyr with maple syrup and vanilla until smooth.
Fill the nests with the skyr cream and berries and serve immediately.

title: Light Black Forest Cherry Dessert in a Glass (Alcohol-Free)
instructions: Bring the cherries to the boil with 40 ml juice and cinnamon, thicken with the blended cornflour and leave to cool.
Stir the quark with yoghurt, maple syrup and vanilla until smooth.
Crumble the ladyfingers, mix with cocoa and place in a glass as the base.
Layer the cherries and quark cream alternately and finish with shaved chocolate and a cherry.

title: Pan-Fried Feta Egg Wrap with Spinach and Tomato
instructions: Beat the eggs and spread them in a pan in the oil over medium heat.
Immediately place the wrap on the still-runny egg, press lightly and let set for 2 minutes, then flip.
Top one half with spinach, diced tomato and crumbled feta and season with chilli and oregano.
Fold over and fry for another 1 minute until the wrap is crisp, then halve.

title: Smashed Chickpea Sandwich with Dill, Cucumber and Mustard
instructions: Roughly mash the chickpeas with a fork.
Mix with yoghurt, mustard, chopped dill, finely diced onion, lemon, salt and pepper.
Toast the bread and top with lettuce, the chickpea smash and cucumber slices.
Close and cut in half diagonally.

title: Aloo Chana Chaat – Indian Chickpea and Potato Street Salad with Pomegranate
ingredients: Chaat masala, cumin, chilli, lime, salt
instructions: Boil the potato in its skin for 20 minutes, peel and dice. Finely dice the tomato, cucumber and onion.
Mix with the potato, chickpeas, oil, pomegranate seeds, coriander, chaat masala, cumin, chilli, lime and salt.
Stir the tamarind paste with 1 tbsp water.
Serve the chaat drizzled with yoghurt and tamarind sauce.

title: Tamago Sando – Japanese Egg Salad Sandwich with Yoghurt
instructions: Hard-boil the eggs for 10 minutes, refresh in cold water and peel.
Finely mash the eggs with a fork and stir with yoghurt, mustard, chives, salt, pepper and a pinch of sugar until creamy.
Spread the egg salad thickly on one slice of bread and cover with the second slice.
Press lightly, trim the crusts if desired and halve.

title: Kimchi Fried Rice with Tofu and Fried Egg
ingredients: Brown rice (uncooked, cooked the day before)
instructions: Dice the tofu and fry in half of the oil for 4 minutes.
Add the chopped kimchi and gochujang and fry for 2 minutes.
Add the rice and fry over high heat for 4 minutes while turning, then season with sesame oil.
Fry the egg in the remaining oil, place on the rice and sprinkle with spring onions, sesame seeds and nori.

title: Light Dal Makhani – Creamy Black Lentils with Kidney Beans and Rice
ingredients: Ginger, garlic, garam masala, cumin, chilli, salt
instructions: Soak the urad lentils overnight and boil in fresh water for 45 minutes until soft.
Fry the onion in the butter until golden brown and toast the ginger, garlic and spices for 1 minute.
Add the passata, lentils and kidney beans and reduce over low heat for 20 minutes until creamy, mashing some of the lentils.
Stir in the yoghurt and serve with rice.

title: Squash and Ricotta Cannelloni with Sage and Tomato Sauce
instructions: Dice the squash and steam for 12 minutes until soft, mash and mix with ricotta, chopped spinach, nutmeg, salt and pepper.
Fill the mixture into a piping bag and fill the uncooked cannelloni with it.
Put half of the passata into a dish, place the cannelloni on top and cover with the remaining sauce.
Top with mozzarella, sage and oil and bake covered at 190 °C for 30 minutes, then uncovered for 10 minutes.

title: Porotos Granados – Chilean Bean, Squash and Corn Stew with Basil
instructions: Dice the onion and pepper and sweat in the oil with paprika for 5 minutes.
Add the diced squash and stock and simmer for 15 minutes until the squash falls apart and thickens the stock.
Add the beans and sweetcorn and cook for another 8 minutes.
Season with oregano and salt and stir in plenty of fresh basil.

title: Atakilt Wat – Ethiopian Cabbage, Potato and Carrot Vegetables with Lentil Misir
instructions: Sweat the onion in half of the oil for 5 minutes until soft, add the turmeric, ginger and garlic and fry the carrots and potatoes in pieces for 5 minutes.
Add the cabbage in strips and a little water, cover and braise for 15 minutes until everything is soft.
For the misir, toast the remaining onion in the remaining oil with tomato paste and berbere, add the lentils and 200 ml water and cook for 15 minutes until creamy.
Serve both on injera or flatbread.

title: Keto eggs Florentine with butter hollandaise on leaf spinach
instructions: Wilt the spinach in a dry pan, squeeze it out and season with salt and nutmeg.
Melt the butter. Whisk the egg yolk with the lemon juice over a hot water bath until foamy, then slowly whisk in the butter.
Poach the eggs in simmering water for 4 minutes.
Place the eggs on the spinach, coat with the hollandaise and season with pepper.

title: Baked avocado with egg, Alpine cheese and chives
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 °C. Halve and stone the avocado and widen the hollows slightly with a spoon.
Slide one egg into each half and sprinkle with grated Alpine cheese.
Bake for about 15 minutes until the egg white has set. Serve with chives, salt and pepper.

title: Cream cheese pancakes with raspberries and flaked almonds
instructions: Blend the cream cheese, eggs, almond flour and cinnamon until smooth and leave to rest for 5 minutes.
Heat the butter in a non-stick pan and cook small pancakes over medium heat for 2 minutes per side.
Toast the flaked almonds in a dry pan and scatter them over the pancakes with the raspberries.

title: Mushroom and Gruyère omelette with thyme
instructions: Slice the mushrooms and fry them in half the butter with the thyme for 4 minutes. Remove.
Whisk the eggs with salt and pepper. Heat the remaining butter and let the eggs set over medium heat.
Put the mushrooms and grated Gruyère on one half, fold the omelette over and let it rest briefly.

title: Halloumi breakfast plate with fried egg, tomato and olives
instructions: Cut the halloumi into 2 slices and fry in half the oil for 2 minutes per side until golden.
Fry an egg in the remaining oil.
Slice the tomato and cucumber, arrange with the olives, halloumi and egg and sprinkle with oregano and pepper.

title: Grain-free nut and coconut granola with Greek yoghurt
instructions: Preheat the oven to 160 °C. Roughly chop the almonds and walnuts and mix with the coconut, pumpkin seeds, cinnamon and melted coconut oil.
Spread on a baking tray and roast for 12 minutes until golden, turning once. Leave to cool.
Put the yoghurt in a bowl and serve topped with the granola and raspberries.

title: Almond and psyllium roll with avocado and egg
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180 °C. Mix the almond flour, psyllium, baking powder and salt, then stir in the egg white and hot water.
Shape a roll with wet hands and bake for 30 minutes.
Boil the egg for 8 minutes, peel and slice it. Cut the roll open and top with mashed avocado and the egg.

title: Goat's cheese and courgette frittata with mint
instructions: Thinly slice the courgette and fry it in the olive oil in an ovenproof pan for 5 minutes.
Whisk the eggs with salt, pepper and half the chopped mint and pour over the courgette. Crumble the goat's cheese on top.
Bake at 180 °C for 12 minutes until set and sprinkle with the remaining mint.

title: Scrambled eggs with smoked salmon, dill crème fraîche and cucumber
instructions: Stir the crème fraîche with the chopped dill and a little pepper.
Whisk the eggs and cook them gently in the butter over low heat, stirring, until creamy.
Serve the scrambled eggs with the smoked salmon, dill crème fraîche and cucumber slices.

title: Warm hemp and flaxseed porridge with coconut milk and blueberries
instructions: Mix the hemp seeds, flaxseed, chia seeds and cinnamon in a small pan.
Add the coconut milk and water and warm for 4 minutes, stirring, until the porridge thickens.
Pour into a bowl and serve with the blueberries.

title: Ground beef breakfast skillet with spinach, mushrooms and fried egg
instructions: Fry the ground beef in the oil until crumbly and season with paprika, salt and pepper.
Add the quartered mushrooms and fry for 4 minutes, then let the spinach wilt in.
Make a well, crack in the egg and cook covered for 4 minutes until set.

title: Mascarpone berry cream with toasted hazelnuts
instructions: Toast the hazelnuts in a dry pan for 3 minutes and chop roughly.
Stir the mascarpone with the yoghurt and vanilla until creamy.
Spoon the cream into a glass and layer with the berries and hazelnuts.

title: Tuscan creamy salmon with spinach and sun-dried tomatoes
instructions: Season the salmon with salt and fry in the olive oil for 3 minutes per side. Remove.
Briefly fry the garlic and chopped tomatoes, stir in the cream and Parmesan and simmer for 2 minutes.
Let the spinach wilt in the sauce, return the salmon to the pan and serve with pepper.

title: Garlic butter chicken thighs with green beans and almonds
instructions: Season the chicken thighs with salt and fry skin-side down for 10 minutes until crisp, then turn and cook for 8 minutes more.
Cook the beans in salted water for 6 minutes and drain.
Foam the butter with the chopped garlic and almonds, toss the beans in it and serve with the chicken and parsley.

title: Butter chicken with cauliflower rice
instructions: Dice the chicken, season with garam masala and salt and brown in half the butter for 6 minutes.
Briefly toast the ginger, garlic and tomato paste, add the passata and cream and simmer for 10 minutes until thick.
Finely grate the cauliflower and sauté in the remaining butter for 5 minutes. Serve with the curry.

title: Sirloin steak with herb butter and broccoli
instructions: Knead the soft butter with the chopped herbs, garlic and a pinch of salt and chill.
Steam the broccoli florets for 5 minutes and drizzle with half the olive oil.
Sear the steak in the remaining oil for 3 minutes per side, rest for 3 minutes, then season with salt and pepper.
Serve with the herb butter and broccoli.

title: Lamb chops with mint gremolata and roasted courgette
instructions: Preheat the oven to 220 °C. Cut the courgette into wedges, toss with half the oil and salt and roast for 20 minutes.
Finely chop the mint, parsley, garlic and lemon zest and mix with the remaining oil.
Season the lamb chops with salt and fry in a hot pan for 3 minutes per side. Serve with the gremolata and courgette.

title: Courgette lasagne with ground beef and ricotta
instructions: Slice the courgette lengthways into thin strips, salt and leave for 10 minutes to draw out water, then pat dry.
Fry the ground beef with the garlic in the oil, add the passata and oregano and simmer for 5 minutes.
Layer the courgette, meat sauce and ricotta in a small dish and finish with the mozzarella.
Bake at 190 °C for 25 minutes and rest for 5 minutes.

title: Cauliflower crust pizza with mozzarella, tomato and rocket
instructions: Preheat the oven to 220 °C. Finely grate the cauliflower, steam for 4 minutes and squeeze out firmly in a cloth.
Knead with the egg, Parmesan, half the mozzarella and salt, spread thinly on baking paper and bake for 15 minutes.
Top with the passata, oregano, tomato slices and remaining mozzarella and bake for 8 minutes.
Serve with rocket and olive oil.

title: Mackerel with mustard butter and green bean cucumber salad
instructions: Cook the beans in salted water for 7 minutes, refresh in cold water and toss with the cucumber slices, olive oil, vinegar and dill.
Fry the mackerel skin-side down in a hot pan for 4 minutes until crisp, turn and cook for 1 minute more.
Foam the butter, stir in the mustard and spoon over the fish. Serve with the salad.

title: Courgette spaghetti Bolognese with ground beef and Parmesan
instructions: Fry the ground beef in half the oil until crumbly, then briefly toast the garlic and tomato paste with it.
Add the chopped tomatoes and oregano and simmer for 10 minutes. Season to taste.
Spiralise the courgette and toss in the remaining oil for 2 minutes.
Serve the courgette noodles with the Bolognese and grated Parmesan.

title: Chicken and broccoli gratin with cream and Gruyère
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 °C. Cut the chicken into pieces, season with salt and brown in a pan for 6 minutes.
Blanch the broccoli florets for 3 minutes and place in a baking dish with the chicken.
Season the cream with nutmeg, salt and pepper, pour over, sprinkle with Gruyère and bake for 20 minutes until golden.

title: Red Thai curry with chicken thigh and coconut milk
instructions: Fry the curry paste with 3 tbsp of the coconut milk in a pot for 2 minutes.
Add the chicken strips and fry for 4 minutes, then pour in the remaining coconut milk.
Add the pepper and courgette in pieces and simmer for 8 minutes.
Season with the fish sauce and lime juice and serve with Thai basil.

title: Aubergine involtini with ricotta, spinach and tomato sauce
instructions: Cut the aubergine lengthways into 4 slices, brush with half the oil and grill for 3 minutes per side.
Wilt the spinach, squeeze it out, chop and mix with the ricotta, hard cheese, toasted pine nuts, salt and pepper.
Spread the filling on the slices, roll up and set on the passata in a dish. Drizzle with the remaining oil.
Bake at 190 °C for 20 minutes and serve with basil.

title: Salmon avocado salad with sesame ginger dressing
instructions: Fry the salmon for 3 minutes per side in a pan and flake into pieces.
Whisk together the sesame oil, soy sauce, grated ginger and lime juice.
Put the lettuce, cucumber and avocado in a bowl, top with the salmon, drizzle with the dressing and sprinkle with sesame.

title: Cobb salad with chicken, egg, avocado and blue cheese
instructions: Season the chicken breast with salt and fry in 1 tsp of the oil for 5 minutes per side, then dice. Hard-boil the egg for 9 minutes.
Spread the lettuce on a plate. Arrange the chicken, diced egg, avocado, tomato and crumbled blue cheese in rows on top.
Whisk the remaining oil with the vinegar, salt and pepper and drizzle over.

title: Beef carpaccio with rocket, capers and Parmesan
instructions: Freeze the beef fillet for 20 minutes, then cut into wafer-thin slices with a sharp knife.
Lay the slices on a cold plate and drizzle with olive oil, lemon juice, salt and pepper.
Toast the pine nuts in a dry pan. Top the carpaccio with rocket, capers, pine nuts and shaved Parmesan.

title: Burger bowl with beef patty, cheddar, gherkin and mustard sauce
instructions: Season the ground beef, shape into a flat patty and fry in the oil for 4 minutes per side. Lay the cheddar on top and let it melt.
Stir the mustard into the sour cream.
Put the lettuce, tomato and gherkin in a bowl, top with the patty in pieces and serve with the mustard sauce.

title: Taco salad with ground beef, avocado, cheese and sour cream
instructions: Fry the ground beef in the oil until crumbly and season with cumin, chilli and salt.
Shred the iceberg lettuce, dice the tomato and avocado and toss with the lime juice.
Spread the beef over the salad and serve with grated cheddar and sour cream.

title: Chicken piccata with lemon caper butter and green asparagus
instructions: Pound the chicken flat, season with salt and pepper and dust lightly with almond flour.
Fry in the olive oil for 4 minutes per side until golden and keep warm.
Fry the asparagus in the pan for 5 minutes. Add the butter, capers and lemon juice and let it foam.
Serve the chicken with the asparagus and sauce and sprinkle with parsley.

title: Braised cucumbers with beef meatballs and dill cream
instructions: Knead the ground beef with the mustard, salt and pepper and shape into 8 small meatballs.
Peel and deseed the braising cucumber and cut into thick pieces.
Brown the meatballs all over in the butter for 5 minutes, add the cucumber and braise for 8 minutes.
Pour in the cream, reduce for 3 minutes and sprinkle with dill.

title: Crustless spinach and salmon quiche with dill
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180 °C. Wilt the spinach, squeeze it out well and chop.
Whisk the eggs with the cream, dill, salt, pepper and nutmeg.
Put the spinach and diced salmon in a small greased dish, pour over the egg mixture and sprinkle with Gruyère.
Bake for 30 minutes until set and golden.

title: Beef roulade with mustard and gherkin in cream sauce with Brussels sprouts
instructions: Season the beef slice, spread with mustard, top with gherkin strips and diced onion, roll up and secure.
Sear the roulade all over in the olive oil, deglaze with the water and braise covered for 90 minutes.
Stir in the cream and reduce the sauce for 5 minutes.
Halve the Brussels sprouts and fry in the butter for 10 minutes. Serve with the roulade and sauce.

title: Meen moilee – Keralan coconut fish with green beans
instructions: Cut the fish into pieces and rub with turmeric and salt.
Sweat the onion, ginger, chilli and curry leaves in the coconut oil for 3 minutes.
Add the coconut milk and beans and simmer for 5 minutes, then add the fish and poach gently for 6 minutes.

title: Salmon burger in portobello mushroom buns with avocado cream
instructions: Finely chop the salmon, mix with the egg white, salt and pepper and shape into a patty.
Brush the portobello mushrooms with half the oil and fry for 4 minutes per side. Fry the patty in the remaining oil for 3 minutes per side.
Mash the avocado with the yoghurt, lemon juice and salt. Sandwich the patty with the avocado cream and rocket between the mushrooms.

title: Broccoli cheddar soup with pumpkin seeds
instructions: Divide the broccoli into florets, peel and dice the stalk and sweat in the butter for 3 minutes.
Pour in the stock and simmer for 10 minutes until tender.
Add the cream, blend until smooth and stir in the grated cheddar until melted. Season to taste.
Toast the pumpkin seeds in a dry pan and scatter over the soup.

title: Creamy mushroom soup with thyme and walnuts
instructions: Dice the onion and fry with the sliced mushrooms and thyme in the butter for 6 minutes.
Pour in the stock and simmer for 8 minutes, then add the cream and Parmesan and blend until smooth.
Roughly chop the walnuts, toast in a dry pan and sprinkle over the soup.

title: Shirataki ramen with chicken thigh, egg and pak choi
instructions: Rinse the shirataki noodles and blanch in boiling water for 2 minutes. Boil the egg for 7 minutes and peel.
Fry the chicken thigh skin-side down for 8 minutes until crisp, turn, cook for 6 minutes more and slice.
Bring the stock to the boil with the ginger and soy sauce and cook the pak choi in it for 2 minutes.
Put the noodles in a bowl, pour over the stock and serve with the chicken, halved egg, spring onion and sesame oil.

title: Wok-fried beef and broccoli with sesame
instructions: Cut the steak into thin strips and marinate with 1 tbsp of the soy sauce.
Stir-fry the broccoli in small florets in the hot rapeseed oil for 4 minutes and remove.
Sear the beef with the ginger and garlic for 2 minutes, then add the broccoli and remaining soy sauce.
Drizzle with sesame oil and sprinkle with toasted sesame seeds.

title: Paneer tikka skewers with peppers and mint yoghurt
instructions: Dice the paneer and marinate with 30 g of the yoghurt, tandoori spice and salt for 20 minutes.
Thread the paneer and pepper pieces alternately onto skewers, brush with ghee and grill for 3 minutes per side.
Mix the remaining yoghurt with the chopped mint, lemon juice and salt and serve with the skewers.

title: Halloumi and courgette skewers with herb oil and lamb's lettuce
instructions: Cut the halloumi and courgette into even cubes and thread alternately onto skewers.
Mix the olive oil with the chopped herbs, lemon juice and pepper and brush the skewers with it.
Grill the skewers in a griddle pan for 8 minutes, turning, and serve on the lamb's lettuce with the remaining herb oil.

title: Baked salmon with pesto crust and roasted tomatoes
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 °C. Mix the pesto and almond flour into a paste.
Season the salmon with salt, place on a tray and spread the pesto paste on top. Scatter the tomatoes alongside with olive oil, salt and pepper.
Bake for 15 minutes until the salmon is cooked and the crust golden.

title: Chicken breast in Gorgonzola spinach sauce
instructions: Season the chicken breast with salt and fry in the butter for 5 minutes per side. Remove.
Add the cream to the pan, melt the Gorgonzola in it and let the spinach wilt.
Slice the chicken, arrange in the sauce and sprinkle with chopped walnuts.

title: Tofu coconut curry with spinach and peanuts
instructions: Dice the tofu and fry in the coconut oil for 6 minutes until golden all over.
Briefly toast the curry paste, pour in the coconut milk and simmer for 5 minutes.
Stir in the spinach, season with lime juice and serve with chopped peanuts.

title: Tuna-stuffed avocado boats with lime and sesame
instructions: Halve and stone the avocado, scoop out a little flesh and dice it.
Drain the tuna and mix with the diced avocado, spring onion, lime juice, olive oil, salt and pepper.
Spoon into the avocado halves and sprinkle with sesame.

title: Pan-fried Arctic char with almond butter and Swiss chard
instructions: Cut the chard into strips, sauté in the olive oil for 4 minutes and season with salt.
Fry the char skin-side down in 1 tsp of the butter for 4 minutes, turn and leave for 1 minute.
Foam the remaining butter with the almonds until light brown, add the lemon juice and spoon over the fish and chard.

title: Cocoa coconut bites with almond butter (fat bombs)
instructions: Melt the coconut oil and stir until smooth with the cream cheese, almond butter, cocoa and vanilla.
Chill the mixture for 20 minutes until firm enough to shape.
Shape into 4 balls, roll in the coconut and keep chilled.

title: Vegetarian hard cheese crisps with rosemary and cucumber sticks
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 °C. Finely grate the hard cheese and spread in 6 small heaps on baking paper, then sprinkle with chopped rosemary.
Bake for 6 minutes until golden and leave to cool on the tray until crisp.
Stir the cream cheese with the olive oil until smooth and serve with the crisps and cucumber sticks.

title: Deviled eggs with avocado cream and paprika
instructions: Hard-boil the eggs for 10 minutes, refresh, peel and halve lengthways.
Remove the yolks and mash with the avocado, olive oil, lemon juice, salt and pepper until creamy.
Pipe the cream into the egg white halves and dust with paprika.

title: Marinated olives with feta, almonds and lemon zest
instructions: Toast the almonds in a dry pan for 3 minutes.
Mix the olives, almonds and diced feta with the olive oil, lemon zest and herbs.
Leave to marinate for at least 10 minutes and serve in a bowl.

title: Greek yoghurt with oven-roasted cinnamon pecans
instructions: Preheat the oven to 160 °C. Whisk the egg white until foamy and mix with the melted butter, cinnamon and salt.
Toss the pecans in the mixture, spread on a baking tray and roast for 15 minutes, turning once. Leave to cool.
Put the yoghurt in a bowl and top with the cinnamon pecans.

title: Salmon tartare on cucumber slices with crème fraîche
instructions: Finely dice the salmon with a sharp knife and mix with the lemon juice, olive oil, salt and pepper.
Cut the cucumber into thick slices and arrange on a platter.
Top the slices with the tartare and garnish each with a dollop of crème fraîche and chives.

title: Celery sticks with cream cheese and walnut filling
instructions: Wash the celery and cut into 8 cm lengths.
Finely chop the walnuts and mix with the cream cheese, chives, salt and pepper.
Spread the filling into the celery pieces and serve chilled.

title: Burrata with cherry tomatoes and basil oil
instructions: Blend the basil with the olive oil and a pinch of salt until fine.
Halve the cherry tomatoes and spread on a plate, placing the burrata in the centre.
Drizzle with the basil oil and serve with pepper.

title: Bresaola rolls with cream cheese and rocket
instructions: Stir the cream cheese with the lemon juice and pepper until smooth.
Lay out the bresaola slices, spread thinly with the cream cheese and top with a little rocket.
Roll up tightly, drizzle with olive oil and serve.

title: Baked Camembert with walnuts, thyme and cucumber sticks
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180 °C. Score the top of the Camembert in a criss-cross and place in a small dish.
Top with thyme and chopped walnuts and bake for 12 minutes until runny inside.
Sprinkle with pepper and serve with cucumber sticks for dipping.

title: Roasted rosemary almonds with sea salt and cucumber radish sticks
instructions: Preheat the oven to 170 °C. Finely chop the rosemary and toss with the almonds, olive oil and sea salt.
Roast on a tray for 12 minutes, turning once, and leave to cool.
Cut the cucumber into sticks and the radishes in half and serve with the almonds.

title: Coconut panna cotta with agar agar and raspberries
instructions: Stir the coconut milk with the vanilla and agar agar and boil for 2 minutes, stirring.
Pour into a glass and chill for at least 2 hours until set.
Lightly crush the raspberries and spread over the panna cotta.

title: Coconut chocolate cream with 85 % chocolate and toasted almonds
instructions: Warm the coconut milk, melt the chopped chocolate in it while stirring and add the vanilla.
Stir in the chia seeds, pour into a glass and chill for 2 hours.
Toast the flaked almonds in a dry pan and sprinkle over the cream.

title: Mascarpone mousse with cocoa and hazelnuts
instructions: Whip the cream until stiff.
Stir the mascarpone with the cocoa and vanilla until smooth and gently fold in the cream.
Spoon into a glass, chill for 20 minutes and sprinkle with toasted chopped hazelnuts.

title: Eggs in pepper rings with chives and cottage cheese
instructions: Cut the pepper into 2 thick rings and dice the rest.
Place the rings in the oil in a pan, crack an egg into each and cook covered for 5 minutes until set.
Mix the cottage cheese with the diced pepper and chives, season and serve alongside.

title: Skyr with rhubarb compote and walnuts
instructions: Cut the rhubarb into pieces and simmer with the maple syrup, vanilla and 2 tbsp water for 8 minutes until soft. Leave to cool.
Roughly chop the walnuts and toast briefly in a dry pan.
Put the skyr in a bowl, spoon the compote on top and sprinkle with walnuts.

title: Scrambled eggs with smoked trout, spinach and cress
instructions: Wilt the spinach in the butter for 1 minute.
Whisk the eggs, add them and cook gently over low heat, stirring, until creamy.
Serve topped with flaked smoked trout and cress and season with pepper.

title: Breakfast salad with poached egg, turkey breast and avocado
instructions: Season the turkey breast with salt, fry for 4 minutes per side and slice into strips.
Poach the egg in simmering water for 4 minutes.
Dress the rocket, tomato and avocado with the oil, lemon juice, salt and pepper and top with the turkey and egg.

title: Lemon ricotta cream with strawberries and pistachios
instructions: Stir the ricotta, quark, lemon zest and vanilla until smooth.
Slice the strawberries and chop the pistachios.
Put the cream in a bowl, top with the strawberries and sprinkle with pistachios.

title: Egg white protein crêpes with quark and raspberry filling
instructions: Whisk the egg whites, egg, almond flour and cinnamon into a thin batter.
Brush a non-stick pan thinly with oil and cook 3 thin crêpes for 1 minute per side.
Stir the quark with half the raspberries, spread on the crêpes, roll up and serve with the remaining raspberries.

title: Cauliflower hash browns with fried egg and chives
instructions: Finely grate the cauliflower, steam for 3 minutes and squeeze out firmly in a cloth.
Mix with 1 egg, the Parmesan, almond flour, salt and pepper and shape into 4 flat patties.
Fry in two thirds of the oil for 4 minutes per side until crisp. Fry the second egg in the remaining oil and serve with chives.

title: Kefir raspberry smoothie with flaxseed and almonds
instructions: Put all the ingredients in a blender.
Blend for 1 minute until smooth.
Pour into a large glass and serve immediately.

title: Baked tomatoes filled with egg and feta
instructions: Preheat the oven to 190 °C. Cut a lid off the tomatoes and hollow out the insides.
Set the tomatoes in a dish, drizzle with olive oil, crack an egg into each and crumble the feta over.
Bake for 20 minutes until the egg white has set and sprinkle with oregano and pepper.

title: Matcha quark cream with blueberries
instructions: Whisk the matcha into the milk until there are no lumps.
Stir the quark with the matcha milk until creamy.
Spoon into a bowl, top with the blueberries and drizzle with almond butter.

title: Turkey escalope with mushroom cream sauce and broccoli
instructions: Pound the turkey breast flat, season with salt and fry in the oil for 3 minutes per side. Keep warm.
Fry the onion and mushrooms in the pan for 5 minutes, pour in the cream and reduce for 2 minutes.
Steam the broccoli for 5 minutes and serve with the escalope and mushroom sauce.

title: Cod loins with mustard sauce and kohlrabi
instructions: Peel the kohlrabi, cut into batons and cook in a little salted water for 8 minutes.
Season the cod with salt and fry in the butter for 3 minutes per side.
Mix the milk with the cornflour, bring to the boil, stir in the mustard and dill and season. Serve with the fish and kohlrabi.

title: Pepper steak strips with pointed cabbage and peppers
instructions: Cut the beef into strips and season with crushed green peppercorns.
Sear in half the oil for 2 minutes and remove.
Fry the cabbage and pepper strips in the remaining oil for 5 minutes, add the beef and soy sauce and toss for 1 minute.

title: Chicken korma with cashews and cauliflower rice
instructions: Soak the cashews in hot water for 10 minutes and blend finely with the yoghurt.
Sweat the onion, ginger and garlic in the ghee for 4 minutes, add the spices and diced chicken and fry for 5 minutes.
Stir in the cashew yoghurt and simmer gently for 10 minutes.
Finely grate the cauliflower, steam for 5 minutes and serve with the korma.

title: Chicken cacciatore with peppers, olives and courgette
instructions: Season the chicken thighs with salt and brown all over in the olive oil for 6 minutes.
Add the onion, pepper and courgette in pieces and fry for 4 minutes.
Add the passata, olives and rosemary and braise covered for 25 minutes.

title: Moo shu chicken in lettuce cups with mushrooms and egg
instructions: Whisk the egg, cook as a thin omelette in the rapeseed oil and cut into strips.
Cut the chicken into fine strips and stir-fry in the sesame oil for 4 minutes.
Stir-fry the mushrooms and finely sliced cabbage for 4 minutes, then add the soy sauce and omelette strips.
Spoon into lettuce leaves and drizzle with hoisin sauce.

title: Baked salmon with green asparagus and lemon yoghurt sauce
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 °C. Spread the asparagus on a tray with the olive oil and salt and place the salmon alongside.
Bake for 15 minutes.
Mix the yoghurt with the lemon juice, dill, salt and pepper and serve alongside.

title: Sichuan beef with celery and carrot
instructions: Cut the beef into fine strips and toss with the cornflour and 1 tsp of the soy sauce.
Fry the beef in the hot oil for 2 minutes until crisp and remove.
Briefly fry the ginger, doubanjiang and Sichuan pepper, then stir-fry the celery and carrot strips for 3 minutes.
Add the beef and remaining soy sauce and toss for 1 minute.

title: Prawn saganaki with feta and tomato
instructions: Sweat the onion and garlic in the olive oil for 3 minutes, add the diced tomatoes and reduce for 10 minutes.
Add the prawns to the sauce and cook for 3 minutes.
Crumble the feta on top, let it soften covered for 2 minutes and sprinkle with oregano.

title: Grilled calamari with rocket, lemon and capers
instructions: Cut open the squid tubes, score the inside in a diamond pattern and marinate with half the oil, the garlic and chilli.
Grill in a very hot griddle pan for 1 minute per side.
Dress the rocket and tomatoes with the remaining oil and lemon juice and top with the calamari and capers.

title: Turkey tandoori with cucumber raita and tomato salad
instructions: Cut the turkey into pieces and marinate with 50 g of the yoghurt, tandoori spice and salt for 20 minutes.
Thread the meat onto skewers, brush with oil and grill in a griddle pan for 10 minutes, turning.
Mix the remaining yoghurt with grated cucumber, mint and salt. Serve with sliced tomatoes and onion.

title: Oven-baked chicken caprese with mozzarella and basil
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 °C. Halve the chicken breast horizontally, season and place in a dish. Spread the sliced courgette alongside.
Top with tomato and mozzarella slices and drizzle with olive oil.
Bake for 20 minutes and serve with fresh basil.

title: Aubergine steaks with tahini, pomegranate and mint
instructions: Preheat the oven to 220 °C. Cut the aubergine lengthways into 3 thick slices, score in a diamond pattern, brush with oil and season.
Bake for 25 minutes until golden and tender.
Stir the tahini with the yoghurt, lemon juice and a little water until smooth, spoon over the aubergine and scatter with pomegranate and mint.
