title: Tofu and broccoli stir-fry with cashews and chilli
instructions: Cut the tofu into cubes, pat dry and fry in the rapeseed oil for 6 minutes until crisp.
Add the broccoli florets, ginger and chilli and stir-fry for 5 minutes.
Toss in the cashews, soy sauce and sesame oil and serve immediately.

title: Beef fillet skewers with chimichurri and grilled peppers
instructions: Finely chop the parsley and garlic and mix with the olive oil, vinegar, oregano, chilli and salt to make chimichurri.
Cut the beef into cubes and thread onto skewers with the pepper pieces.
Grill the skewers in a hot griddle pan for 8 minutes, turning, and serve with the chimichurri.

title: Turkey roulade with spinach cream cheese filling and red cabbage
instructions: Finely shred the red cabbage and braise covered with the grated apple, stock and salt for 25 minutes.
Pound the turkey breast flat, spread with the cream cheese, top with spinach, roll up and secure.
Brown the roulade all over in the oil and cook covered over medium heat for 15 minutes. Slice and serve with the red cabbage.

title: Yam nua – Thai beef salad with cucumber, mint and lime
instructions: Sear the beef in the oil for 3 minutes per side, rest for 5 minutes and slice thinly.
Mix the lime juice, fish sauce, sugar and chilli into a dressing.
Toss the cucumber, tomato, onion, lettuce and herbs with the beef and dressing.

title: Gỏi gà – Vietnamese chicken cabbage salad with herbs
instructions: Poach the chicken breast in gently simmering water for 15 minutes, leave to cool and shred.
Finely shred the cabbage, cut the carrot into strips and the onion into rings.
Whisk the lime juice, fish sauce, sugar and oil, toss with the vegetables, chicken and herbs and sprinkle with chopped peanuts.

title: Ssam – Korean beef lettuce wraps with kimchi and cucumber
instructions: Thinly slice the beef and marinate with the soy sauce, garlic and half the sesame oil for 10 minutes.
Sear in a very hot pan for 2 minutes.
Mix the gochujang with the remaining sesame oil. Serve the beef, kimchi, cucumber strips and spring onion in lettuce leaves with the sauce.

title: Carne asada with pico de gallo and avocado
instructions: Marinate the beef with the oil, half the lime juice, cumin, chilli and salt for 15 minutes.
Finely dice the tomato and onion and mix with the coriander, remaining lime juice and salt to make pico de gallo.
Grill the beef in a hot griddle pan for 3 minutes per side, slice and serve with the pico de gallo and avocado slices.

title: Pollo a la brasa with cucumber tomato salad and ají sauce
instructions: Rub the chicken with the garlic, cumin, paprika, salt and half the oil and leave for 20 minutes.
Roast in the oven at 220 °C for 25 minutes until the spice crust is deeply browned.
Blend the chilli and coriander with the yoghurt and lime juice. Toss the cucumber, tomato and onion with the remaining oil and salt and serve everything together.

title: Anda curry – Indian egg curry with spinach
instructions: Hard-boil the eggs for 9 minutes, peel and score lightly all over.
Fry the onion, ginger and garlic in the oil for 5 minutes until golden, add the spices and passata and simmer for 8 minutes.
Stir in the spinach and yoghurt, halve the eggs, add to the sauce and heat for 3 minutes.

title: Chicken jalfrezi with peppers and onions
instructions: Dice the chicken and season with turmeric, chilli and salt.
Fry in the oil over high heat for 5 minutes and add the ginger, garlic and garam masala.
Add the pepper and onion in large pieces and the diced tomato and stir-fry for 6 minutes until the vegetables are still crisp. Serve with chilli and coriander.

title: Stracciatella alla romana – Roman egg and spinach soup with chicken
instructions: Poach the chicken breast in the stock for 12 minutes, remove and dice.
Whisk the eggs with the grated Parmesan, lemon zest and nutmeg.
Add the spinach to the simmering stock, then pour in the egg mixture while stirring constantly until fine shreds form. Add the chicken and serve.

title: Pointed cabbage chicken stir-fry with ginger and sesame
instructions: Cut the chicken into strips and sear in the rapeseed oil for 4 minutes.
Add the cabbage in strips, the carrot in fine batons and the grated ginger and stir-fry for 5 minutes.
Season with the soy sauce and sesame oil and sprinkle with toasted sesame seeds.

title: Chicken with 40 cloves of garlic and green beans
instructions: The classic recipe uses 40 cloves for 4 servings; for 1 serving use 10 unpeeled cloves. Preheat the oven to 180 °C.
Season the chicken and brown all over in the oil in an ovenproof pot for 6 minutes.
Add the garlic cloves, thyme and water, cover and braise in the oven for 40 minutes.
Cook the beans in salted water for 6 minutes and serve with the chicken. Squeeze the soft cloves out of their skins.

title: Courgette and tomato tian with goat's cheese
instructions: Preheat the oven to 190 °C. Finely dice the onion and garlic and scatter into a small dish.
Thinly slice the courgette and tomatoes and layer them alternately on their edges in the dish.
Season with the olive oil, thyme, salt and pepper and bake for 35 minutes.
Crumble the goat's cheese on top and bake for a further 8 minutes.

title: Brussels sprouts skillet with chicken and walnuts
instructions: Halve the Brussels sprouts and fry cut-side down in the olive oil for 8 minutes until browned.
Add the diced chicken and onion and fry for 6 minutes more.
Stir in the mustard and roughly chopped walnuts and season.

title: Plain veal escalope with asparagus rocket salad
instructions: Peel the lower third of the asparagus, cut into pieces and fry in 1 tsp of the oil for 5 minutes. Leave to cool.
Pound the escalope flat, season and fry in the remaining oil except 1 tbsp for 2 minutes per side.
Dress the rocket, asparagus and halved tomatoes with 1 tbsp oil, the lemon juice and shaved Parmesan and serve with the escalope.

title: Lemon pepper chicken thighs with roasted broccoli
instructions: Preheat the oven to 210 °C. Marinate the chicken with the lemon juice, lemon pepper, garlic, salt and half the oil.
Toss the broccoli florets with the remaining oil and salt and put on a tray with the chicken.
Roast for 25 minutes until the chicken is cooked and the broccoli crisp at the edges.

title: Hungarian chicken paprikash with sour cream and cucumber salad
instructions: Cut the chicken into strips and brown in the oil for 5 minutes.
Add the pepper strips, tomato paste and paprika, toast briefly, pour in the passata and simmer for 12 minutes.
Stir in the sour cream. Serve with salted and peppered cucumber slices.

title: Prawn and broccoli wok with garlic and ginger
instructions: Divide the broccoli into florets and blanch for 2 minutes.
Briefly fry the garlic and ginger in the rapeseed oil, then cook the prawns for 3 minutes.
Add the broccoli, soy sauce and sesame oil, toss for 2 minutes and serve with spring onion.

title: Tarragon chicken with carrots and sugar snap peas
instructions: Season the chicken and fry in half the butter for 5 minutes per side. Remove.
Cut the carrots into batons and halve the sugar snaps, then sauté in the remaining butter for 6 minutes.
Stir the yoghurt with the tarragon and lemon juice and serve with the chicken and vegetables.

title: Pollo en salsa verde – chicken in tomatillo sauce with courgette
instructions: Halve the tomatillos and roast with the garlic and half the oil at 220 °C for 10 minutes, then blend with the coriander, lime and chilli.
Fry the chicken strips in the remaining oil for 6 minutes, then cook the courgette slices for 4 minutes.
Pour the salsa verde over and let it simmer for 3 minutes.

title: Merluza en salsa verde – hake with mussels and asparagus
instructions: Cut the asparagus into 3 cm pieces and blanch for 4 minutes.
Fry the garlic in the oil, cook the hake for 3 minutes per side, then add the mussels and stock.
Fold in the parsley and asparagus, simmer for 2 minutes and serve.

title: Lemongrass chicken skewers with cucumber peanut salad
instructions: Dice the chicken and marinate with chopped lemongrass, oil, chilli and salt for 15 minutes, then thread onto skewers.
Grill the skewers in a griddle pan for 8 minutes, turning.
Mix the cucumber and spring onion with lime, mint and chopped peanuts and serve with the skewers.

title: Egg drop soup with tofu and mushrooms
instructions: Bring the stock to a boil with the ginger and soy sauce, then simmer the shiitake and tofu cubes for 5 minutes.
Drizzle the beaten eggs into the soup while stirring.
Serve with the sesame oil and spring onion.

title: Veal osso buco with gremolata and fennel
instructions: Season the veal and brown all over in the oil, then remove. Fry the fennel wedges for 5 minutes.
Add the tomatoes and stock, return the meat and braise covered for 70 minutes.
Chop the parsley, lemon zest and garlic into gremolata and scatter over the meat.

title: Turkey and cucumber rolls with cream cheese
instructions: Mix the cream cheese with the chives, salt and pepper.
Slice the cucumber lengthways into thin ribbons.
Spread the turkey slices with cream cheese, top with cucumber, roll up and secure.

title: Tuna yoghurt dip with pepper and kohlrabi sticks
instructions: Mash the tuna with the yoghurt, lemon juice, dill, salt and pepper.
Cut the pepper and kohlrabi into sticks.
Serve the dip with the vegetable sticks.

title: Radish and chive quark with kohlrabi sticks
instructions: Finely dice the radishes and mix with the quark, chives, salt and pepper.
Cut the kohlrabi into sticks.
Serve the quark with the kohlrabi sticks.

title: Marinated mushrooms with herbs
instructions: Quarter the mushrooms and fry in half the oil for 4 minutes, then leave to cool.
Whisk the remaining oil with the vinegar, garlic, oregano, salt and pepper.
Marinate the mushrooms for 10 minutes and serve with parsley.

title: Courgette rolls with ricotta and mint
instructions: Slice the courgette lengthways into thin ribbons, brush with oil and grill for 1 minute per side.
Mix the ricotta with the mint, lemon zest, salt and pepper.
Put a spoonful of ricotta on each courgette slice, roll up and secure.

title: Air-fryer chicken wings with lemon pepper
instructions: Marinate the wings with the oil, lemon juice, lemon pepper and salt.
Air-fry at 200 °C for 22 minutes until crisp, turning once.
Dust with extra lemon pepper and serve hot.

title: Kohlrabi carpaccio with walnut pesto
instructions: Slice the kohlrabi paper-thin and arrange on a plate.
Blend the walnuts, parsley, garlic, oil and lemon juice into a pesto and season.
Drizzle the pesto over the carpaccio and serve at once.

title: Htipiti – roasted pepper and feta dip with cucumber sticks
instructions: Roast the pepper at 220 °C for 20 minutes, then peel and deseed.
Roughly blend with the feta, oil, lemon juice and oregano.
Serve with cucumber sticks.

title: Salmon rillettes on chicory leaves
instructions: Mash the salmon with the crème fraîche, dill, lemon juice and pepper.
Separate the chicory into leaves.
Spoon the rillettes onto the leaves and serve.

title: Strawberries with mint skyr dip
instructions: Stir the skyr with the chopped mint and lemon zest.
Wash and halve the strawberries.
Serve with the mint skyr dip.

title: Almond skyr cream with cocoa and raspberries
instructions: Roughly chop the almonds and toast in a dry pan for 2 minutes.
Stir the skyr with the cocoa until smooth.
Serve the cream topped with the raspberries and almonds.

title: Grilled peach with ricotta and pistachios
instructions: Halve and stone the peach and lightly oil the cut sides.
Grill in a griddle pan for 3 minutes per side.
Serve with the ricotta and chopped pistachios.

title: Greek yoghurt with fresh figs, walnuts and thyme honey
instructions: Spoon the yoghurt into a bowl and lightly drizzle with olive oil.
Quarter the figs and place them on top.
Serve with the walnuts and thyme honey.

title: Wholemeal ricotta toast with courgette, lemon and mint
instructions: Slice the courgette thinly and fry in the oil for 3 minutes.
Toast the bread and spread with the ricotta.
Top with the courgette, lemon zest and mint and season with pepper.

title: Chickpea and spinach breakfast skillet with poached egg
instructions: Fry the garlic in the oil, then cook the chickpeas and diced tomato for 5 minutes.
Wilt in the spinach and season with cumin and salt.
Poach the egg for 4 minutes and place it on the skillet.

title: Savoury wholemeal pancake with feta, spinach and dill
instructions: Mix the flour, egg, yoghurt and a pinch of salt into a batter.
Heat the oil in a pan, pour in the batter and cook for 3 minutes per side.
Briefly wilt the spinach and serve on the pancake with crumbled feta and dill.

title: Bulgur breakfast bowl with orange, dates and pistachios
instructions: Soak the bulgur in twice its volume of boiling water for 12 minutes.
Segment the orange and chop the dates.
Serve the bulgur with yoghurt, oil and cinnamon, topped with orange, dates and pistachios.

title: Avocado tomato wholemeal bread with white beans and oregano
instructions: Toast the bread. Mash the avocado and season with salt and oregano.
Spread the toast with avocado and top with tomato slices and beans.
Drizzle with olive oil and season with pepper.

title: Courgette and feta muffins with wholemeal flour
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180 °C. Grate the courgette and squeeze out the liquid.
Mix the flour, egg, oil, yoghurt, dill and baking powder, then fold in the courgette and crumbled feta.
Divide into 3 muffin cases and bake for 22 minutes.

title: Fig and almond smoothie with yoghurt
instructions: Roughly chop the figs and almonds.
Blend with the yoghurt, oil and water until creamy.
Serve immediately.

title: Tomato and olive wholemeal roll with fresh goat's cheese
instructions: Split and lightly toast the roll.
Spread with the goat's cheese and top with tomato slices and olives.
Drizzle with olive oil and oregano.

title: Pomegranate yoghurt with barley flakes and pistachios
instructions: Spoon the yoghurt into a bowl and drizzle with olive oil.
Scatter the barley flakes on top.
Serve with the pomegranate seeds and pistachios.

title: Oven-baked sea bass with fennel, orange and olives
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 °C. Cut the fennel into wedges and place in a dish with oil and salt.
Pre-bake for 10 minutes, then top with the sea bass, orange slices and olives.
Bake for 15 minutes more and serve with pepper.

title: Wholemeal linguine with clams, parsley and lemon
instructions: Cook the linguine in salted water until al dente.
Fry the garlic in the oil, add the clams and cook for 4 minutes.
Toss the pasta with the parsley and lemon juice and serve.

title: Revithia – Greek oven chickpea stew with lemon and rosemary
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180 °C. Dice the onion and carrot and fry in the oil for 5 minutes.
Add the chickpeas, rosemary, salt and 100 ml water and transfer to a baking dish.
Braise for 40 minutes and finish with the lemon juice.

title: Kotopoulo lemonato – lemon oregano chicken with roast potatoes
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 °C. Dice the potatoes and pre-roast with half the oil for 15 minutes.
Marinate the chicken with lemon juice, oregano, garlic and the remaining oil.
Add to the vegetables and roast for 25 minutes.

title: Chicken giouvetsi with wholemeal orzo and tomato
instructions: Dice the chicken and fry with the onion and garlic in the oil for 6 minutes.
Add the tomatoes, oregano and 150 ml water, then stir in the orzo.
Simmer covered for 18 minutes until the orzo is tender.

title: Insalata di farro – farro salad with tomatoes, cucumber, mozzarella and basil
instructions: Dice the tomato and cucumber and tear the mozzarella.
Toss with the farro, basil, oil and lemon juice.
Season and serve at once.

title: Ribollita – Tuscan vegetable bean stew with cavolo nero and wholemeal bread
instructions: Sweat the onion, carrot and celery in the oil for 8 minutes.
Add the tomatoes, beans and 200 ml water and simmer for 15 minutes.
Fold in the cavolo nero and bread cubes, simmer for 10 minutes and serve.

title: Peperonata with white beans and wholemeal bread
instructions: Slice the peppers and onion and braise in the oil for 12 minutes.
Add the tomatoes and beans and simmer for 8 minutes.
Serve with toasted wholemeal bread.

title: Wholemeal spaghetti alla puttanesca with olives and capers
instructions: Cook the spaghetti until al dente.
Melt the garlic and anchovies in the oil, then simmer the tomatoes, olives and capers for 10 minutes.
Toss the pasta in the sauce and serve.

title: Orzotto – barley risotto with pumpkin, sage and hard cheese
instructions: Fry the onion in the oil and toast the barley for 2 minutes.
Add the diced pumpkin and 250 ml hot water gradually, stirring for 25 minutes.
Stir in the Parmesan and sage and serve.

title: Insalata di mare with prawns, mussels and squid
instructions: Poach the seafood for 3 minutes and refresh in cold water.
Marinate with oil, lemon, garlic and parsley.
Arrange with cucumber.

title: Pisto manchego – Spanish stewed vegetables with fried egg
instructions: Dice the vegetables and braise with onion in the oil for 15 minutes.
Simmer the tomatoes for 5 minutes.
Top with a fried egg.

title: Musakhan – Palestinian sumac chicken with onions and wholemeal flatbread
instructions: Braise the onions with oil and sumac for 10 minutes.
Roast the chicken on top at 200 °C for 25 minutes.
Serve on the flatbread with walnuts.

title: Samak harra – Lebanese chilli fish with tahini walnut sauce and bulgur
instructions: Soak the bulgur for 12 minutes.
Fry the fish in the oil for 4 minutes per side.
Spoon tahini sauce over and serve with bulgur and parsley.

title: Blitva – Dalmatian chard with potatoes and pan-fried hake
instructions: Cook the potatoes for 12 minutes and chop the chard.
Fry the garlic in the oil, toss chard and potatoes for 5 minutes.
Fry the hake for 3 minutes per side and serve alongside.

title: Psari plaki – Greek oven fish with tomatoes and onions
instructions: Oven 190 °C. Layer onions and tomatoes, drizzle with oil.
Bake the fish on top for 25 minutes.
Scatter with parsley and garlic.

title: Oven chicken with artichokes, lemon and olives
instructions: Marinate chicken with oil, lemon, oregano and garlic.
Roast with artichokes and olives at 200 °C for 30 minutes.
Serve at once.

title: Wholemeal busiate with Trapanese almond tomato pesto
instructions: Cook the pasta al dente.
Blend almonds, tomato, basil, garlic and oil into pesto.
Toss the pasta with the pesto.

title: Salmon trout with almond herb crust and bean tomato vegetables
instructions: Chop almonds and parsley, mix with oil.
Bake fish with crust at 200 °C for 15 minutes.
Toss beans and tomatoes for 5 minutes and serve alongside.

title: Stuffed squid with herb rice in tomato sauce
instructions: Parboil rice for 12 minutes and mix with herbs.
Stuff the squid and secure.
Brown, add tomatoes and braise for 20 minutes.

title: Sicilian tuna steak with tomatoes, capers and olives
instructions: Sear the tuna in the oil for 2 minutes per side and remove.
Braise garlic, tomatoes, capers and olives for 5 minutes.
Return the fish and let it rest briefly.

title: Polpette di melanzane – aubergine balls in tomato sauce
instructions: Bake aubergine at 200 °C for 25 minutes until soft, scoop out and mash.
Mix with flour, egg, Parmesan and salt, shape into balls and fry in oil.
Simmer in tomato sauce with garlic and basil for 10 minutes.

title: Grilled mackerel with parsley lemon salad and wholemeal pita
instructions: Grill the mackerel with oil and salt for 3 minutes per side.
Mix parsley and cucumber with lemon juice and oil.
Serve with the pita.

title: Monkfish skewers with peppers and lemon bulgur
instructions: Soak bulgur for 12 minutes and mix with lemon and parsley.
Thread fish and pepper onto skewers and grill for 8 minutes.
Serve with the bulgur.

title: Molokhia – Egyptian jute stew with chicken and rice
instructions: Cook the rice. Poach the chicken in stock for 15 minutes and shred.
Fry garlic in oil, simmer molokhia with stock for 10 minutes.
Stir in the chicken and serve with rice.

title: Chorba frik – Algerian freekeh soup with chicken and chickpeas
instructions: Fry onion and carrot in oil, brown diced chicken for 5 minutes.
Simmer tomatoes, freekeh, chickpeas and 300 ml water for 25 minutes.
Serve with coriander.

title: Acquacotta – Tuscan vegetable soup with poached egg and wholemeal bread
instructions: Sweat onion and celery in oil, simmer tomatoes with 250 ml water for 15 minutes.
Wilt in the spinach and place bread in the bowl.
Poach the egg on top and serve.

title: Pesce all'acqua pazza – fish in tomato herb broth
instructions: Fry garlic in oil, simmer tomatoes and water for 5 minutes.
Add the fish and cook for 8 minutes.
Serve with parsley.

title: Marmitako – Basque tuna and potato stew
instructions: Fry onion and pepper in oil, toast tomato paste briefly.
Simmer potatoes with 200 ml water for 15 minutes.
Cook the tuna cubes for 3 minutes.

title: Caldo verde – Portuguese kale potato soup with white beans
instructions: Fry onion and garlic in oil, cook potatoes with 300 ml water for 15 minutes and mash.
Simmer finely shredded kale and beans for 8 minutes.
Drizzle with olive oil.

title: Lentejas estofadas – Spanish lentil stew with peppers and vegetables
instructions: Fry the vegetables in oil, add lentils, tomatoes and 300 ml water.
Simmer for 25 minutes.
Season and serve.

title: Wholemeal tagliatelle with porcini, thyme and parsley
instructions: Cook the pasta al dente.
Fry porcini with garlic and thyme in oil for 6 minutes.
Toss with the pasta and serve with parsley and Parmesan.

title: Grilled vegetables with lentils, feta and mint oil
instructions: Cook lentils for 20 minutes. Grill the vegetables.
Blend mint with half the oil.
Arrange everything, crumble feta and drizzle mint oil.

title: Tuscan-style prawns with white beans and tomatoes
instructions: Fry garlic in oil and cook prawns for 3 minutes.
Stew tomatoes and beans for 4 minutes.
Serve with basil.

title: Sheet-pan chickpeas and roast vegetables with yoghurt tahini
instructions: Oven 210 °C. Roast vegetables and chickpeas with oil for 25 minutes.
Mix yoghurt with tahini and lemon.
Spoon the sauce over the tray.

title: Kale pesto wholemeal pasta with white beans
instructions: Cook pasta. Blend kale, almonds, garlic, oil and lemon into pesto.
Toss pasta and beans with the pesto.
Serve at once.

title: Saffron chicken with fennel and chickpeas
instructions: Brown the chicken in oil and remove.
Braise fennel and onion for 8 minutes, add saffron and 100 ml water.
Cook chicken and chickpeas for 12 minutes more.

title: Soupies me spanaki – Greek cuttlefish with spinach
instructions: Fry onion in oil and braise squid for 10 minutes.
Wilt in the spinach.
Finish with lemon and dill.

title: Kolokithia me avga – Greek courgette potato skillet with feta and egg
instructions: Fry sliced potatoes and courgette in oil for 12 minutes.
Crack the egg over and let it set, crumble the feta.
Serve with dill.

title: Prawn bulgur pilaf with peppers and dill
instructions: Fry onion and pepper in oil, toast bulgur for 2 minutes.
Add 100 ml water and soak for 12 minutes.
Cook the prawns for 4 minutes and serve with dill.

title: Chicken lentil salad with rocket and pomegranate
instructions: Cook lentils for 20 minutes, grill chicken and slice.
Toss with rocket, pomegranate, oil and lemon.
Serve at once.

title: Ratatouille with polenta cakes
instructions: Cook polenta with 160 ml water for 8 minutes, cool and cut into cakes.
Braise vegetables in oil into ratatouille for 20 minutes.
Fry the polenta cakes and serve with ratatouille and basil.

title: Chickpea rocket salad with grilled peppers and feta
instructions: Grill, peel and slice the pepper.
Toss with chickpeas, rocket, oil and lemon.
Crumble the feta on top.

title: Wholemeal penne with broccoli, chickpeas and lemon
instructions: Cook pasta and broccoli together.
Fry garlic in oil, add chickpeas and lemon.
Toss everything and serve with Parmesan.

title: Sicilian roast cauliflower with raisins and pine nuts
instructions: Roast cauliflower florets with oil at 210 °C for 25 minutes.
Toast the pine nuts in a dry pan.
Toss with raisins, parsley and lemon.

title: Adas bi hamod – Lebanese lemon lentils with chard
instructions: Cook lentils and potatoes for 20 minutes.
Fry onion and garlic in oil and wilt the chard.
Combine everything with lemon juice.

title: Baked ricotta with tomato olive salad and wholemeal bread
instructions: Put ricotta in a dish, drizzle with oil and oregano, bake at 180 °C for 15 minutes.
Mix tomatoes and olives with basil.
Serve with the bread.

title: Pappa al pomodoro – Tuscan tomato bread soup with white beans
instructions: Fry garlic in oil and simmer tomatoes for 10 minutes.
Fold in bread cubes and beans and thicken for 10 minutes.
Serve with basil and olive oil.

title: Fatayer bi sabanekh – Lebanese spinach pastries
instructions: Knead flour with 30 ml water and 5 g oil into dough, rest 20 minutes.
Sauté spinach and onion with sumac, lemon and remaining oil.
Roll out dough, fill, shape into triangles and bake at 200 °C for 18 minutes.

title: Skordalia light – Greek potato almond dip with vegetables
instructions: Cook potatoes and blend with almonds, garlic, oil and lemon.
Cut cucumber and carrot into sticks.
Serve the dip with the vegetable sticks.

title: Antipasti plate with grilled peppers, courgette and fresh goat's cheese
instructions: Grill the pepper and courgette.
Marinate with oil and basil.
Arrange with the goat's cheese.

title: Olive tapenade on wholemeal crackers
instructions: Roughly blend olives, capers, garlic, oil and lemon.
Cut the bread into crackers and toast.
Spread with the tapenade.

title: Boquerones – marinated anchovies with wholemeal bread
instructions: Marinate anchovies with oil, lemon, garlic and parsley for 10 minutes.
Toast the bread.
Arrange the anchovies on the bread.

title: Red lentil pepper dip with wholemeal pita
instructions: Cook lentils for 15 minutes. Roast and peel the pepper.
Blend everything with oil, lemon and cumin.
Serve with the pita.

title: Panisse – oven chickpea fries with lemon yoghurt
instructions: Stir chickpea flour with water and salt into a batter, cook 5 minutes and cool.
Cut into sticks and roast with oil at 210 °C for 20 minutes.
Mix yoghurt with lemon and serve alongside.

title: Marinated butter beans with dill and lemon
instructions: Mix the beans with oil, lemon, garlic and dill.
Marinate for 10 minutes.
Serve cold.

title: Orange olive oil cake with almonds
instructions: Oven 170 °C. Grind almonds and mix with flour and baking powder.
Stir in egg, oil, honey and orange juice.
Bake for 25 minutes and leave to cool.

title: Baked figs with yoghurt and pistachios
instructions: Halve the figs and bake with oil at 180 °C for 12 minutes.
Serve with yoghurt and honey.
Scatter with pistachios.

title: Wholemeal biscotti with almonds and orange
instructions: Oven 170 °C. Knead dough from flour, egg, honey, oil, zest and almonds.
Shape into a log, bake 20 minutes, then slice.
Bake again for 10 minutes until crisp.

title: Baked oranges with cinnamon, yoghurt and almonds
instructions: Slice the oranges, bake with oil and cinnamon at 180 °C for 15 minutes.
Serve with yoghurt.
Scatter with almonds.

title: Apple millet bake with yoghurt
instructions: Oven 180 °C. Parboil millet with water and salt for 12 minutes.
Mix with diced apple, oil and cinnamon and bake for 20 minutes.
Serve with yoghurt.

title: Kefir bowl with berries, oats and flaxseed
instructions: Pour the kefir and yoghurt into a bowl.
Stir in the oats.
Top with berries and diced apple.

title: Vegetable scrambled eggs with spinach, mushrooms and cherry tomatoes
instructions: Fry mushrooms and tomatoes in oil for 4 minutes.
Wilt in the spinach, whisk the eggs and stir in.
Season and cook until softly set.

title: Wholemeal toast with ricotta, strawberries and basil
instructions: Toast the bread and spread with ricotta.
Top with strawberries and basil.
Drizzle with olive oil.

title: Yoghurt with banana, blueberries and sunflower seeds
instructions: Spoon the yoghurt into a bowl.
Top with banana slices.
Serve with blueberries and seeds.

title: Melon berry salad with mint yoghurt
instructions: Dice the melon and mix with the berries.
Stir the yoghurt with the mint.
Serve the salad with the yoghurt.

title: Apple carrot muffins with wholemeal flour
instructions: Oven 180 °C. Grate apple and carrot.
Mix with flour, egg, oil, yoghurt, cinnamon and baking powder.
Bake in 3 cases for 22 minutes.

title: Poached eggs on leaf spinach with tomatoes and wholemeal bread
instructions: Wilt the spinach in the oil and season.
Poach the eggs for 4 minutes.
Serve on the spinach with tomato slices and bread.

title: Peach ginger smoothie with yoghurt and oats
instructions: Stone and roughly chop the peach.
Blend with yoghurt, oats, ginger and water until creamy.
Serve immediately.

title: Tomato cucumber breakfast salad with egg and herbs
instructions: Boil the egg for 8 minutes and quarter it.
Dice tomato and cucumber and mix with oil, herbs and salt.
Arrange with the egg.

title: Salmon in herb yoghurt with barley and green vegetables
instructions: Cook the barley for 20 minutes.
Pan-fry the salmon in the oil for 3 minutes per side.
Stir the yoghurt with dill and lemon.
Serve with the vegetables and barley.

title: Chicken vegetable stew with barley
instructions: Dice the chicken and brown in the oil.
Add vegetables and barley, cover with stock.
Simmer for 25 minutes and finish with herbs.

title: Turkey breast with pepper zucchini vegetables and quinoa
instructions: Cook the quinoa for 15 minutes.
Pan-fry the turkey for 4 minutes per side.
Sauté pepper and zucchini for 8 minutes; finish with lemon and oregano.

title: Cod on a bed of vegetables with dill potatoes
instructions: Cook the potatoes for 15 minutes and toss with dill.
Bake vegetables and cod with oil and lemon at 180 °C for 18 minutes.
Serve with the dill potatoes.

title: Green lentil vegetable skillet with yoghurt and mint
instructions: Cook the lentils until soft, about 20 minutes.
Sauté the vegetables in oil for 10 minutes and stir in the lentils.
Serve with yoghurt, mint and lemon.

title: Ginger chicken wok with broccoli, pepper and brown rice
instructions: Cook the rice for 25 minutes.
Stir-fry chicken strips with ginger and garlic in the oil.
Add vegetables for 5 minutes and deglaze with soy sauce.

title: Bean and pepper goulash with wholemeal bread
instructions: Sauté onion and pepper in the oil.
Simmer beans, tomatoes and spices for 15 minutes.
Serve with wholemeal bread.

title: Quinoa vegetable skillet with egg and herbs
instructions: Cook the quinoa for 15 minutes.
Sauté the vegetables in oil and stir in the quinoa.
Crack the eggs on top, let them set and finish with herbs.

title: Trout en papillote with zucchini, carrots and parsley potatoes
instructions: Cook potatoes 15 minutes; toss with parsley and 2 g oil.
Bake trout with vegetables, remaining oil and lemon in foil at 180 °C for 18 minutes.
Serve with the parsley potatoes.

title: Lemon chicken with asparagus and new potatoes
instructions: Cook the potatoes for 15 minutes.
Roast the chicken with lemon and oil at 190 °C for 20 minutes.
Roast the asparagus for 6 minutes and plate everything.

title: Wholemeal penne with broccoli, peas and ricotta lemon sauce
instructions: Cook the pasta; add broccoli and peas for the last 4 minutes.
Mix ricotta with lemon, oil and nutritional yeast.
Toss everything together and season.

title: Vegetable barley risotto with peas and asparagus
instructions: Sweat the onion in oil and toast the barley.
Add stock gradually and cook for 25 minutes.
Cook peas and asparagus for 5 minutes; stir in nutritional yeast and yoghurt.

title: Pollock vegetable curry with light coconut and rice
instructions: Cook the rice for 25 minutes.
Toast spices and ginger in oil, then soften the vegetables.
Simmer coconut milk and pollock for 8 minutes; wilt in the spinach.

title: Pumpkin chickpea stew with spinach
instructions: Sauté onion and pumpkin in the oil.
Simmer chickpeas and stock for 15 minutes.
Stir in the spinach and serve with yoghurt.

title: Chicken breast with peach salsa and wild rice
instructions: Cook the wild rice for 35 minutes.
Pan-fry the chicken for 5 minutes per side.
Mix peach with onion, lime and coriander for the salsa.

title: Salmon spinach salad with oranges and walnuts
instructions: Pan-fry the salmon without added fat for 3 minutes per side and flake.
Arrange spinach with orange segments and cucumber.
Stir yoghurt with lemon and top with the salmon.

title: Baked tofu with broccoli, pepper and millet
instructions: Cook the millet for 15 minutes.
Roast tofu and vegetables with oil and soy sauce at 200 °C for 20 minutes.
Serve with millet and sesame.

title: Mushroom barley soup with carrots
instructions: Sauté onion and mushrooms in the oil.
Simmer barley, carrots and stock for 25 minutes.
Serve with thyme and a spoon of yoghurt.

title: Turkey breast salad with strawberries, spinach and almonds
instructions: Pan-fry the turkey and slice into strips.
Arrange spinach with strawberries and almonds.
Top with balsamic and the turkey.

title: Hake with tomato pepper vegetables and wholemeal couscous
instructions: Steep the couscous in hot water for 5 minutes.
Braise the vegetables in oil for 8 minutes.
Cook the hake on top for 6 minutes; serve with parsley and couscous.

title: Oven yoghurt chicken with cumin carrots and bulgur
instructions: Marinate the chicken in yoghurt and lemon.
Bake with carrots, oil and cumin at 190 °C for 25 minutes.
Cook the bulgur for 12 minutes and serve alongside.

title: Broccoli potato gratin with yoghurt egg topping
instructions: Parboil potatoes and broccoli for 10 minutes.
Layer in a dish and pour over the yoghurt-egg mix.
Bake at 180 °C for 20 minutes.

title: Chicken couscous salad with cucumber, mint and orange
instructions: Steep the couscous; cook and dice the chicken.
Chop cucumber and orange and mix with mint.
Toss everything with oil and lemon.

title: Pan-fried pike-perch with beetroot vegetables and potatoes
instructions: Cook potatoes and beetroot for 20 minutes.
Pan-fry the pike-perch for 3 minutes per side.
Stir yoghurt with horseradish and dill and serve.

title: Vegetable millet skillet with chickpeas and yoghurt
instructions: Cook the millet for 15 minutes.
Sauté vegetables and chickpeas in the oil.
Stir in the millet and serve with yoghurt.

title: Beetroot lentil salad with oranges and lamb's lettuce
instructions: Cook lentils 20 minutes; cook and dice the beetroot.
Mix with orange segments, lamb's lettuce and walnuts.
Dress with oil and vinegar.

title: Chicken pineapple skillet with pepper and rice
instructions: Cook the rice for 25 minutes.
Stir-fry chicken and pepper in the oil.
Add pineapple and soy sauce, simmer briefly; serve with spring onion and rice.

title: Black bean corn salad with avocado and lime
instructions: Drain and mix the beans and corn.
Dice the tomato and avocado.
Toss with lime, oil and coriander.

title: Turkey medallions with apple red cabbage and mashed potatoes
instructions: Cook the potatoes and mash with yoghurt.
Braise red cabbage and apple with vinegar for 15 minutes.
Pan-fry the turkey and plate with the sides.

title: Asparagus potato salad with egg and herb yoghurt
instructions: Cook potatoes and asparagus; boil the egg.
Mix yoghurt with mustard, oil and chives.
Toss together and top with the egg.

title: Edamame quinoa salad with mango and lime
instructions: Cook quinoa 15 minutes; blanch the edamame.
Dice the mango and cucumber.
Mix with lime, oil and coriander.

title: Skinless chicken thighs with roasted root vegetables and herb yoghurt
instructions: Season vegetables and chicken with oil; roast at 200 °C for 30 minutes.
Stir the yoghurt with the herbs.
Plate together.

title: Unsalted nut mix with apricots and pumpkin seeds
instructions: Mix the nuts and seeds.
Chop the apricots and apple.
Serve together as a snack.

title: Frozen grapes with yoghurt dip
instructions: Freeze the grapes for 2 hours.
Stir yoghurt with lemon zest and honey.
Dip the grapes into the yoghurt.

title: Lentil carrot spread with vegetable sticks
instructions: Cook lentils and carrots until soft.
Blend with oil, lemon and cumin.
Serve with cucumber and pepper sticks.

title: Grapefruit orange salad with mint
instructions: Segment the grapefruit and orange.
Mix with mint.
Serve with yoghurt.

title: Apple carrot raw salad with walnuts
instructions: Grate the apple and carrots.
Mix with lemon and walnuts.
Serve with yoghurt.

title: Edamame pea salad with mint
instructions: Blanch the edamame and peas.
Mix with mint, oil and lemon.
Serve with yoghurt.

title: Poached peach with vanilla yoghurt
instructions: Poach the peach in hot water for 5 minutes.
Stir yoghurt with vanilla and honey.
Top with the peach and sprinkle with almonds.

title: Apple cinnamon yoghurt with toasted almonds
instructions: Dry-toast the almonds.
Dice the apple and mix with cinnamon.
Spoon over yoghurt and drizzle with honey.

title: Sweet potato roesti with fried egg and avocado
instructions: Grate the sweet potato and fry as rösti in coconut oil.
Fry the eggs alongside.
Serve with avocado slices and chives.

title: Banana egg pancakes with almond butter and berries
instructions: Mash banana with eggs and cinnamon.
Cook as pancakes in coconut oil.
Top with almond butter and berries.

title: Coconut yoghurt with mango, kiwi and almonds
instructions: Spoon the coconut yoghurt into a bowl.
Top with sliced mango and kiwi.
Sprinkle with almonds and coconut flakes.

title: Fried eggs on roasted peppers and zucchini with herb oil
instructions: Roast peppers and zucchini with 6 g oil at 200 °C for 20 minutes.
Fry the eggs in the remaining oil.
Serve on the vegetables with herb oil.

title: Apple cinnamon pancakes made with almond flour
instructions: Mix almond flour with eggs and cinnamon; fold in grated apple.
Cook as pancakes in coconut oil.
Serve with berries.

title: Banana almond muffins with blueberries
instructions: Oven 180 °C. Mash banana and mix with egg, almond flour, oil and raising agent.
Fold in blueberries and fill 3 cases.
Bake for 20 minutes.

title: Egg crêpes with chicken, spinach and avocado
instructions: Whisk the eggs and cook into thin crêpes.
Quickly sauté the chicken and spinach.
Fill the crêpes and roll with avocado.

title: Berry nut salad with coconut flakes and mint
instructions: Wash and arrange the berries.
Roughly chop the nuts.
Serve with coconut flakes, mint and coconut yoghurt.

title: Beef stew with root vegetables and rosemary
instructions: Brown the beef in the oil.
Add vegetables and braise with stock for 40 minutes.
Finish with rosemary.

title: Lemon rosemary chicken with roasted pumpkin and Brussels sprouts
instructions: Toss everything with oil, lemon and rosemary.
Roast at 200 °C for 30 minutes.
Serve hot.

title: Salmon with mango avocado salsa and roasted asparagus
instructions: Roast asparagus with 4 g oil at 200 °C for 12 minutes.
Pan-fry salmon in remaining oil for 3 minutes per side.
Serve with mango-avocado salsa with lime and coriander.

title: Lamb curry with coconut milk, spinach and sweet potato
instructions: Brown the lamb and onion in the oil.
Simmer sweet potato, curry, ginger and coconut milk for 25 minutes.
Wilt in the spinach.

title: Pumpkin chicken soup with ginger and coconut
instructions: Sauté onion, ginger and pumpkin in the oil.
Simmer with stock and chicken for 20 minutes, then blend.
Stir in the coconut milk.

title: Tuna steak with avocado cucumber salsa
instructions: Sear the tuna for 2 minutes per side.
Dice avocado and cucumber; mix with lime and coriander.
Serve the salsa with the steak.

title: Pot-au-feu with beef, leek, carrots and celery
instructions: Simmer the beef in stock for 40 minutes.
Add vegetables and cook for 15 minutes.
Serve with parsley.

title: Prawn coconut curry with zucchini and Thai basil
instructions: Toast ginger and lemongrass in the oil.
Simmer zucchini and coconut milk for 8 minutes.
Cook prawns for 4 minutes; finish with basil and lime.

title: Mushroom chicken skillet with thyme and kale
instructions: Brown the chicken in oil and remove.
Sauté mushrooms and garlic; wilt in the kale.
Return the chicken and finish with thyme.

title: Mackerel with fennel apple salad and dill
instructions: Pan-fry the mackerel for 4 minutes per side.
Finely slice the fennel and apple.
Dress with lemon, oil and dill and serve with the fish.

title: Leg of lamb with aubergine tomatoes and mint
instructions: Roast the lamb with oil and garlic at 200 °C for 30 minutes.
Roast aubergine and tomato alongside for 20 minutes.
Scatter with mint.

title: Chicken pineapple skewers with coconut lime sauce
instructions: Thread chicken, pineapple and pepper onto skewers.
Grill or pan-fry in oil for 12 minutes.
Warm coconut milk with lime and serve as sauce.

title: Cod with pepper almond romesco and roasted fennel
instructions: Roast fennel and pepper with 6 g oil at 200 °C for 20 minutes.
Blend roasted pepper with almonds, garlic, oil and lemon into romesco.
Pan-fry the cod for 8 minutes; serve with sauce and fennel.

title: Beef vegetable wok with coconut aminos and cashews
instructions: Stir-fry the beef strips in oil.
Add vegetables and ginger for 5 minutes.
Deglaze with coconut aminos and top with cashews.

title: Prawn avocado salad with grapefruit
instructions: Cook the prawns in oil for 3 minutes.
Segment the grapefruit and slice the avocado.
Arrange on lamb's lettuce with lime.

title: Grilled chicken thighs with peach salad
instructions: Grill or pan-fry the chicken with oil for 20 minutes.
Slice peach and cucumber; mix with rocket.
Dress with lemon and serve with the chicken.

title: Beef goulash with peppers and parsnip mash
instructions: Brown the beef and onion in the oil.
Braise peppers, paprika and stock for 35 minutes.
Cook and mash the parsnips; serve alongside.

title: Steamed salmon with ginger, pak choi and broccoli
instructions: Steam the salmon with ginger for 10 minutes.
Steam the vegetables for 5 minutes.
Drizzle with sesame oil and coconut aminos.

title: Venison ragout with chestnuts and Brussels sprouts
instructions: Brown the venison and onion in the oil.
Braise with stock and chestnuts for 30 minutes.
Cook the Brussels sprouts separately and serve alongside.

title: Scallops with cauliflower mash and spinach
instructions: Cook the cauliflower and mash with 4 g oil.
Sear scallops in remaining oil for 2 minutes per side.
Quickly wilt the spinach and plate with lemon.

title: Arctic char with herb salad and roasted parsnips
instructions: Roast parsnips with 5 g oil at 200 °C for 25 minutes.
Pan-fry the char for 3 minutes per side.
Serve with the lemon-dressed herb salad.

title: Almond-crusted chicken breast with cucumber dill salad
instructions: Coat the chicken in egg white and ground almonds.
Pan-fry for 6 minutes per side.
Serve cucumber with dill and lemon as a salad.

title: Stuffed portobello mushrooms with beef mince and spinach
instructions: Brown the mince and onion in oil; wilt in the spinach.
Stuff the portobellos and bake at 200 °C for 15 minutes.
Scatter with thyme.

title: Moroccan-style pumpkin beef stew with cinnamon
instructions: Brown the beef and onion in the oil.
Braise pumpkin, tomato, spices and stock for 35 minutes.
Season and serve.

title: Lamb rump with pumpkin mash and kale
instructions: Cook the pumpkin and mash with 4 g oil.
Pan-fry the lamb for 4 minutes per side.
Quickly sauté kale with garlic and serve alongside.

title: Halibut with asparagus and lemon herb oil
instructions: Roast asparagus with 4 g oil at 200 °C for 12 minutes.
Pan-fry the halibut for 3 minutes per side.
Drizzle with lemon herb oil.

title: Coconut almond bars with dates
instructions: Finely chop the dates and almonds.
Knead with coconut flakes and almond butter.
Shape into bars and chill briefly.
Serve with berries.

title: Roasted pumpkin and sunflower seeds with paprika and apple slices
instructions: Dry-toast the seeds with paprika.
Cut the apple into wedges.
Serve together as a snack.

title: Almond flaxseed crackers with avocado cream
instructions: Knead almond flour, flaxseed and egg white into a dough and roll thin.
Bake crisp at 160 °C for 15 minutes.
Mash avocado with lemon and serve alongside.

title: Grain-free zucchini nut muffins
instructions: Oven 180 °C. Grate the zucchini.
Mix with almond flour, egg, oil, cinnamon and raising agent; fold in walnuts.
Bake in 3 cases for 20 minutes.

title: Berries with coconut whipped cream
instructions: Whip the coconut cream until stiff.
Flavour with vanilla.
Spoon over the berries.

title: Peach coconut sorbet with lime
instructions: Freeze the peach, then blend with coconut milk.
Stir in the lime juice.
Serve with coconut flakes.

title: Shiozake breakfast with rice, miso soup and cucumber
instructions: Cook the rice for 25 minutes.
Lightly salt and pan-fry the salmon for 6 minutes.
Dissolve miso in hot water; serve with cucumber, nori and sesame.

title: Sardines on wholemeal toast with tomato and parsley
instructions: Toast the bread.
Top with sardines and tomato slices.
Drizzle with oil, lemon and parsley.

title: Crab toast with egg and chives
instructions: Boil and dice the egg.
Mix crab with yoghurt, lemon and egg.
Spread on bread and top with chives.

title: Potato roesti with smoked trout and horseradish yoghurt
instructions: Grate the potatoes and fry as rösti in oil.
Mix yoghurt with horseradish and dill.
Plate with the trout and dip.

title: Spelt crêpes with smoked salmon and cucumber
instructions: Mix flour, egg and water into a batter and cook the crêpes.
Fill with yoghurt, salmon and cucumber.
Roll with dill.

title: Egg Foo Young – prawn omelette with spring onions
instructions: Whisk the eggs and fold in prawns and vegetables.
Cook as an omelette in the oil.
Drizzle with soy sauce.

title: Salade niçoise with tuna, egg, beans and potatoes
instructions: Cook the potatoes, beans and egg.
Arrange with tomato, olives and tuna.
Dress with oil and vinegar.

title: Goan fish curry with cod, tomatoes and tamarind
instructions: Cook the rice for 25 minutes.
Toast onion and spices in oil; add tomato and tamarind.
Simmer coconut milk and cod for 8 minutes.

title: Sake no nanbanzuke – marinated salmon with vegetables and rice
instructions: Cook the rice. Fry the salmon and cut into pieces.
Quickly sauté the vegetables.
Marinate everything in vinegar and soy sauce; serve with rice.

title: Shrimp and grits light – prawns on cornmeal with peppers
instructions: Cook cornmeal in stock for 10 minutes; stir in yoghurt.
Sauté prawns and pepper in the oil.
Serve on the grits with spring onion.

title: Fish pie – British fish bake with potato topping
instructions: Cook the potatoes and mash with 40 g yoghurt.
Place fish and peas with remaining yoghurt and dill in a dish.
Cover with mash and bake at 190 °C for 20 minutes.

title: Pad Thai with prawns
instructions: Soak the noodles.
Stir-fry prawns and egg in oil; add noodles and sauce.
Serve with sprouts, spring onion and peanuts.

title: Wholemeal tagliatelle with smoked salmon, peas and lemon yoghurt
instructions: Cook the pasta; add peas for the last 3 minutes.
Mix yoghurt with lemon and dill.
Toss with smoked salmon strips.

title: Salmon spinach lasagne with wholemeal sheets
instructions: Cook and flake the salmon; wilt the spinach.
Layer sheets with salmon, spinach, tomato and yoghurt.
Bake at 180 °C for 25 minutes.

title: Tilapia with mango salsa and coconut rice
instructions: Cook the rice with coconut milk and water for 25 minutes.
Pan-fry the tilapia for 3 minutes per side.
Serve with mango salsa with lime and coriander.

title: Thai-style mussels in coconut lemongrass broth
instructions: Cook the rice. Clean the mussels.
Boil lemongrass and ginger in coconut milk; cook mussels for 6 minutes.
Finish with lime and spring onion; serve with rice.

title: Redfish with mustard cucumber vegetables and potatoes
instructions: Cook the potatoes for 15 minutes.
Pan-fry the redfish for 3 minutes per side.
Mix cucumber with mustard, yoghurt and dill; serve alongside.

title: Risotto with prawns and lemon
instructions: Sweat the onion in oil and toast the rice.
Add stock for 18 minutes; add prawns for the last 5 minutes.
Finish with lemon, Parmesan and parsley.

title: Ochazuke – Japanese rice with salmon and green tea
instructions: Cook the rice; pan-fry and flake the salmon.
Arrange rice with salmon, nori and sesame.
Pour hot green tea over; finish with soy sauce and spring onion.

title: Halászlé – Hungarian fish goulash with paprika
instructions: Sauté onion and pepper in oil; stir in paprika.
Simmer tomato and stock for 10 minutes.
Cook the fish pieces for 8 minutes.

title: Beet barley risotto with salmon
instructions: Simmer barley in stock for 25 minutes.
Dice beetroot, sauté with onion in oil and fold into the barley.
Pan-fry salmon 3 minutes per side; serve with dill.

title: Finkenwerder-style plaice with crab and potato salad
instructions: Cook potatoes and dress with yoghurt, dill and lemon.
Pan-fry plaice 2–3 minutes per side.
Top with crab; serve with potato salad.

title: Tuna tataki with sesame and cucumber salad
instructions: Coat tuna in sesame; sear 45 seconds per side.
Marinate cucumber with lime and spring onion.
Slice tuna; drizzle with soy and sesame oil.

title: Prawn asparagus stir-fry with glass noodles
instructions: Soak the glass noodles.
Stir-fry asparagus and prawns with garlic and ginger for 5 minutes.
Toss in noodles and soy sauce.

title: Light salmon Wellington in filo with spinach
instructions: Wilt spinach with onion and squeeze dry.
Top salmon with spinach, wrap in filo, brush with oil.
Bake at 200 °C for 20 minutes; serve with lemon and dill.

title: Godeungeo jorim – Korean braised mackerel with radish
instructions: Cook rice; slice the radish.
Braise mackerel with radish, soy, ginger and garlic for 20 minutes.
Finish with sesame oil and spring onion; serve with rice.

title: Yosenabe – Japanese fish tofu hotpot with Chinese cabbage
instructions: Heat stock with soy sauce.
Simmer cabbage, shiitake and tofu for 5 minutes.
Cook fish and prawns 4 minutes; finish with spring onion.

title: Hua Dan Xia Ren – prawns with scrambled egg and rice
instructions: Cook the rice.
Sauté prawns 2 minutes; add eggs and scramble softly.
Serve over rice with spring onion and soy.

title: Pla Rad Prik – fish with chilli tamarind sauce and rice
instructions: Cook rice; pan-fry fish until crisp.
Sauté garlic and chilli; simmer tamarind and lime into sauce.
Pour sauce over fish; serve with spring onion and rice.

title: Canh chua cá – Vietnamese sour fish soup with pineapple and tomato
instructions: Simmer stock with tomato and pineapple for 8 minutes.
Poach the fish for 5 minutes.
Finish with lime, sprouts, coriander and spring onion.

title: Ikan bakar – grilled fish with sambal and cucumber
instructions: Cook rice; rub fish with oil.
Grill or pan-fry fish 4 minutes per side.
Serve with sambal, lime and cucumber slices.

title: Sudado de pescado – Peruvian fish stew with tomato and rice
instructions: Cook rice; sauté onion and pepper in oil.
Add tomato, simmer 8 minutes; poach fish 6 minutes.
Finish with lime and coriander; serve with rice.

title: Camarones a la diabla with rice
instructions: Cook the rice.
Sauté garlic and chilli; simmer tomatoes 5 minutes.
Cook prawns 4 minutes; serve with lime and rice.

title: Escovitch fish – Jamaican fish with pickled vegetables
instructions: Cook rice; pan-fry fish until crisp.
Simmer vegetables with vinegar and chilli for 5 minutes.
Spoon vegetables over fish; serve with rice.

title: Thieboudienne light – Senegalese fish with rice and vegetables
instructions: Sauté onion and tomato in oil; add water.
Cook vegetables and rice for 25 minutes.
Poach fish on top for 8 minutes; finish with parsley.

title: Lohikeitto – Finnish salmon soup with potatoes and dill
instructions: Cook vegetables in stock for 15 minutes.
Poach diced salmon for 5 minutes.
Take off heat; stir in yoghurt and dill.

title: Hamburg pan-fried fish with mustard sauce and fried potatoes
instructions: Fry potato slices in oil until golden.
Pan-fry fish 3 minutes per side.
Mix mustard with yoghurt, dill and lemon; serve alongside.

title: Brandade light – cod potato mash with salad
instructions: Cook potatoes and cod.
Mash with oil, garlic, yoghurt and lemon.
Serve with lamb's lettuce.

title: Atún encebollado – Spanish tuna with onions
instructions: Cook rice; slowly cook onions in oil for 12 minutes.
Sear tuna 2 minutes per side; deglaze with paprika and vinegar.
Serve on onions with parsley and rice.

title: Amritsari Machli – spiced oven fish with mint raita
instructions: Marinate fish with chickpea flour, cumin, lemon and 4 g oil.
Bake at 200 °C for 18 minutes.
Serve with raita of yoghurt, mint and cucumber.

title: Haemul pajeon – Korean seafood pancake
instructions: Mix flour, egg and a little water; fold in seafood and spring onion.
Pan-fry in oil until golden on both sides.
Serve with soy sauce for dipping.

title: Tuna bake – tuna pasta bake with peas
instructions: Cook pasta al dente; add peas near the end.
Mix with tuna, tomato and yoghurt; place in a dish.
Top with cheese; bake at 200 °C for 15 minutes.

title: Prawn udon soup with pak choi
instructions: Cook udon in the stock.
Add pak choi, ginger and prawns for 4 minutes.
Season with soy, sesame oil and spring onion.

title: Gratinated pollock with broccoli and mashed potato
instructions: Cook potatoes and broccoli; mash potatoes with yoghurt.
Place pollock in a dish with oil and lemon; top with cheese.
Bake at 200 °C for 12 minutes; serve with mash and broccoli.

title: Sardine kefta in tomato sauce with wholemeal bread
instructions: Mix sardines with flour, parsley and cumin into kefta.
Brown in oil; add onion and tomato and simmer 10 minutes.
Serve with wholemeal bread.

title: Prawn mango salad with rice noodles and mint
instructions: Soak rice noodles; briefly sauté prawns.
Toss with mango, cucumber, mint, lime and sesame oil.
Scatter with peanuts.

title: Light prawn cocktail with yoghurt sauce
instructions: Cook prawns briefly or use ready-cooked.
Mix yoghurt with lemon and dill.
Arrange on lettuce with tomato and cucumber; add sauce.

title: Sardine cream on wholemeal crackers
instructions: Mash sardines with yoghurt, lemon and dill.
Spread on crispbread.
Serve with cucumber slices.

title: Smoked trout horseradish dip with vegetables
instructions: Flake the smoked trout finely.
Mix with yoghurt and horseradish.
Serve with vegetable sticks.

title: Wakame salad with sesame and prawns
instructions: Soak wakame 5 minutes; drain.
Cook prawns briefly.
Toss with sesame oil, vinegar, soy and sesame.

title: Lactose-free porridge with blueberries, walnuts and maple syrup
instructions: Simmer oats with milk for 5 minutes.
Top with berries, walnuts and maple syrup.
Plate and serve.

title: Scrambled eggs with chives on spelt sourdough with tomato
instructions: Toast the bread.
Soft-scramble eggs in oil; fold in chives.
Serve on bread with tomato slices.

title: Lactose-free yoghurt with kiwi, strawberries and pumpkin seeds
instructions: Spoon yoghurt into a bowl.
Top with kiwi, strawberries and pumpkin seeds.
Serve immediately.

title: Quinoa breakfast porridge with banana and peanut butter
instructions: Simmer quinoa in milk for 12 minutes.
Serve with banana, peanut butter and cinnamon.
Plate and serve.

title: Polenta breakfast with egg and spinach
instructions: Cook polenta in stock for 10 minutes.
Wilt spinach in oil; fry the egg.
Serve polenta with spinach and egg.

title: Buckwheat pancakes with maple syrup and strawberries
instructions: Mix flour, egg and milk into a batter.
Cook small pancakes in the oil.
Serve with strawberries and maple syrup.

title: Lactose-free quark with orange and almonds
instructions: Spoon quark into a bowl.
Top with orange segments and almonds.
Serve immediately.

title: Pineapple kiwi smoothie with lactose-free yoghurt
instructions: Blend all ingredients.
Serve immediately.
Pour into a glass.

title: Chicken rice stir-fry with carrots, zucchini and spring onion greens
instructions: Cook the rice.
Stir-fry chicken and vegetables with ginger in oil for 8 minutes.
Fold in rice and soy; top with spring onion greens.

title: Oven salmon with herb polenta and carrots
instructions: Roast carrots with 4 g oil at 200 °C for 20 minutes.
Cook polenta in stock 10 minutes; fold in dill.
Bake salmon with remaining oil and lemon for 12 minutes.

title: Gluten-free spaghetti with beef meatballs in tomato sauce
instructions: Form mince with egg into balls; brown in oil.
Simmer with tomato and carrot for 15 minutes.
Cook pasta; serve with sauce and basil.

title: Mild coconut chicken curry with pumpkin, spinach and rice
instructions: Cook rice; brown chicken and pumpkin in oil.
Simmer with coconut milk, ginger and curry for 15 minutes.
Fold in spinach; serve with rice.

title: Beef wok with pak choi, carrots and rice noodles
instructions: Soak the rice noodles.
Sear beef strips; stir-fry vegetables and ginger 4 minutes.
Toss in noodles and soy; top with spring onion greens.

title: Potato spring onion green soup with smoked salmon
instructions: Cook potatoes in stock 15 minutes; blend.
Stir in spring onion greens; finish with yoghurt.
Top with smoked salmon and dill.

title: Crispy tofu with peanut lime sauce, pak choi and rice
instructions: Cook rice; cube tofu and fry crisp in sesame oil.
Mix peanut butter with lime, soy and ginger into a sauce.
Steam pak choi briefly; serve everything with rice.

title: Chicken quinoa salad with cucumber, tomato and feta
instructions: Cook quinoa; pan-fry and dice the chicken.
Toss with cucumber, tomato, feta, oil and lemon.
Finish with parsley.

title: Prawn rice salad with pineapple and coriander
instructions: Cook rice and cool.
Briefly pan-fry the prawns.
Toss with pineapple, cucumber, lime, oil and coriander.

title: Steamed cod with basmati rice, pak choi and carrots
instructions: Cook the rice; steam the carrot slices.
Steam cod and pak choi for 8 minutes.
Serve over rice with oil, lemon and chives.

title: Turkey rice bowl with carrot, cucumber and sesame ginger dressing
instructions: Cook rice; pan-fry turkey and slice.
Whisk sesame oil, ginger and soy into a dressing.
Assemble bowl with carrot, cucumber, sesame and dressing.

title: Beef fillet with lactose-free potato gratin and spinach
instructions: Bake sliced potatoes with milk and nutmeg at 190 °C for 25 minutes.
Pan-fry steak 3 minutes per side.
Wilt spinach briefly and serve alongside.

title: Halloumi polenta skillet with tomato and basil
instructions: Cook polenta in stock for 10 minutes.
Pan-fry halloumi and tomato in oil for 5 minutes; wilt the spinach.
Serve polenta with the vegetables and basil.

title: Corn tortillas with chicken, lettuce, tomato and lime yoghurt
instructions: Pan-fry chicken in oil and shred.
Mix yoghurt with lime.
Fill tortillas with chicken, lettuce, tomato and yoghurt.

title: Polenta with tomato aubergine ragout and mozzarella
instructions: Sauté aubergine in oil; simmer with tomato 12 minutes.
Cook polenta in stock for 10 minutes.
Serve with ragout, mozzarella and basil.

title: Trout fillet on quinoa with zucchini and lemon
instructions: Cook quinoa; sauté zucchini in oil.
Pan-fry trout 3 minutes per side.
Serve on quinoa with zucchini, lemon and dill.

title: Chicken with maple mustard glaze, roasted carrots and potatoes
instructions: Roast potatoes and carrots with 5 g oil at 200 °C for 25 minutes.
Brush chicken with maple and mustard; bake 18 minutes.
Serve with the vegetables.

title: Chicken spinach lasagne with gluten-free sheets
instructions: Cook and shred chicken; wilt spinach.
Layer sheets with chicken, spinach, tomato and yoghurt.
Top with cheese; bake at 180 °C for 25 minutes.

title: Tuna rice salad with corn and cucumber
instructions: Cook rice and cool.
Mix with tuna, corn, cucumber, oil and lemon.
Finish with dill.

title: Potato tofu curry with green beans
instructions: Cook rice; brown potatoes and tofu in oil.
Simmer with coconut milk, ginger and curry 12 minutes; add beans.
Serve with rice.

title: Pollock with sesame crust, rice and cucumber salad
instructions: Cook rice; marinate cucumber in vinegar.
Coat pollock in sesame; pan-fry 3 minutes per side.
Serve with soy sauce, rice and cucumber salad.

title: Potato egg salad with cucumber and chives
instructions: Cook potatoes and egg.
Mix yoghurt with mustard, oil and chives.
Toss everything with cucumber.

title: Millet with chicken, pak choi and peanuts
instructions: Cook the millet.
Stir-fry chicken and pak choi with ginger in sesame oil.
Serve with millet, soy sauce and peanuts.

title: Oyakodon – Japanese chicken egg rice bowl without onion
instructions: Cook the rice.
Simmer chicken with stock, soy and ginger for 6 minutes.
Pour beaten eggs over to set; serve on rice with spring onion greens.

title: Beef sirloin steak with rosemary potatoes and lamb's lettuce
instructions: Roast potatoes with rosemary and 6 g oil at 200 °C for 25 minutes.
Pan-fry steak in remaining oil 3 minutes per side.
Serve with lamb's lettuce and lemon.

title: Lemon thyme chicken with basmati rice and green beans
instructions: Cook rice; steam beans 6 minutes.
Bake chicken with oil, lemon and thyme at 200 °C for 18 minutes.
Serve with rice and beans.

title: Rice cakes with peanut butter and banana
instructions: Spread rice cakes with peanut butter.
Top with banana slices.
Eat right away.

title: Gluten-free peanut butter oat cookies
instructions: Knead everything into a dough.
Shape cookies; bake at 180 °C for 12 minutes.
Allow to cool.

title: Vegetable sticks with peanut lime dip
instructions: Cut vegetables into sticks.
Stir peanut butter with lime and water until creamy.
Serve dip with vegetable sticks.

title: Cheese grape skewers with cucumber
instructions: Alternate cheese and grapes on skewers.
Serve with cucumber slices.
Serve fresh.

title: Lemon polenta cakes with blueberries
instructions: Mix polenta, egg, oil, syrup and lemon.
Bake in moulds at 180 °C for 18 minutes.
Serve with blueberries.

title: Strawberries in dark chocolate with walnuts
instructions: Gently melt the chocolate.
Dip strawberries; sprinkle with chopped walnuts.
Chill until set.

title: Buckwheat yoghurt bowl with cherries and almonds
instructions: Cook buckwheat and cool.
Serve with yoghurt, cherries and almonds.
Serve immediately.

title: Pumpernickel with herb quark, radishes and cucumber
instructions: Mix quark with chives.
Spread on pumpernickel.
Top with radishes and cucumber.

title: Oat bran blueberry muffins without sugar
instructions: Mix all ingredients except berries; fold berries in.
Bake in moulds at 180 °C for 18 minutes.
Allow to cool.

title: Barley porridge with apple, cinnamon and walnuts
instructions: Simmer barley in water for 15 minutes.
Dice apple and cook briefly with the barley.
Serve with cinnamon, walnuts and yoghurt.

title: Soy yoghurt bowl with pear and hazelnuts
instructions: Spoon soy yoghurt into a bowl.
Top with pear slices and hazelnuts.
Serve immediately.

title: Apple cinnamon quark with flaxseed and oat bran
instructions: Mix quark with cinnamon and oat bran.
Top with diced apple and flaxseed.
Serve immediately.

title: Savoury barley flakes with spinach, egg and tomato
instructions: Soak barley flakes in stock for 8 minutes.
Wilt spinach; fry the egg.
Serve with tomato.

title: Yoghurt with plums, walnuts and cinnamon
instructions: Spoon yoghurt into a bowl.
Top with plums, walnuts and cinnamon.
Serve immediately.

title: Strawberry soy oat shake with flaxseed
instructions: Blend everything.
Serve immediately.
Pour into a glass.

title: Chickpea waffles with tomato cucumber salad
instructions: Mix flour, egg, water and cumin into a batter.
Cook in a waffle iron or pan.
Serve with tomato cucumber salad.

title: Kidney bean quinoa patties on leaf salad with yoghurt dip
instructions: Cook quinoa; mash beans with quinoa, egg and cumin into patties.
Pan-fry 3 minutes per side.
Serve on salad with yoghurt dip and parsley.

title: Barley salad with chicken, apple and walnuts
instructions: Cook barley 25 minutes; pan-fry chicken.
Toss with apple, walnuts, oil and lemon.
Serve on lamb's lettuce.

title: Wholemeal penne with chicken, broccoli and tomatoes
instructions: Cook pasta and broccoli.
Sauté chicken and tomatoes with garlic in oil.
Toss everything together and serve.

title: Chickpea chicken salad with pepper and cumin yoghurt
instructions: Pan-fry and dice the chicken.
Mix yoghurt with cumin and lemon.
Serve with chickpeas, pepper and lettuce.

title: White bean turkey stew with kale
instructions: Brown turkey and carrots in oil.
Simmer with tomato and beans for 15 minutes.
Add kale for 5 minutes; finish with thyme.

title: Wholemeal fusilli with tuna, chickpeas and rocket
instructions: Cook the pasta.
Toss with tuna, chickpeas, oil and lemon.
Fold in the rocket.

title: Lentil ragout with roasted aubergine and yoghurt
instructions: Roast aubergine with 4 g oil at 200 °C for 20 minutes.
Simmer lentils with onion, tomato and cumin for 20 minutes.
Serve with aubergine and yoghurt.

title: Edamame buckwheat salad with sesame and cucumber
instructions: Cook buckwheat and edamame.
Toss with cucumber, sesame oil, soy and lime.
Scatter with sesame.

title: Barley pilaf with edamame, spinach and lemon feta
instructions: Cook barley in stock for 20 minutes.
Cook edamame and spinach in oil for 4 minutes.
Serve over barley with feta, lemon and parsley.

title: Wheat berry salad with feta, cucumber and herbs
instructions: Cook wheat berries 30 minutes; cool.
Toss with cucumber, tomato, feta, oil and lemon.
Finish with herbs.

title: Turkey lentil stew with carrots and thyme
instructions: Brown turkey and carrots in oil.
Simmer lentils, tomato and stock for 20 minutes.
Finish with thyme.

title: Lamb lentil stew with mint and yoghurt
instructions: Brown lamb and onion in oil.
Simmer with lentils, tomato and cumin for 25 minutes.
Serve with yoghurt and mint.

title: Roasted cauliflower with beluga lentils and tahini yoghurt
instructions: Roast cauliflower with oil at 200 °C for 25 minutes.
Cook lentils; mix tahini with yoghurt and lemon.
Serve everything with parsley.

title: Chickpea kale stew with tomatoes
instructions: Sauté onion and garlic in oil.
Simmer with tomato, chickpeas and cumin for 10 minutes.
Add kale for 5 minutes.

title: Pollock with white beans in tomato sauce
instructions: Sauté garlic; simmer tomato and beans 8 minutes.
Poach pollock for 6 minutes.
Finish with parsley and lemon.

title: Wholemeal spaghetti with spinach walnut pesto and peas
instructions: Cook pasta and peas.
Blend spinach, walnuts, oil and lemon into pesto.
Toss with pasta and Parmesan.

title: Cocido light – Spanish chickpea stew with chicken and vegetables
instructions: Cook chicken and vegetables in stock for 20 minutes.
Add chickpeas for 5 minutes.
Finish with parsley and oil.

title: Vegetarian feijoada with black beans, pumpkin and kale
instructions: Cook rice; sauté onion and pumpkin in oil.
Simmer with beans, tomato and paprika for 12 minutes.
Fold in kale; serve with rice.

title: Roasted broccoli with white beans and lemon
instructions: Roast broccoli with oil and garlic at 200 °C for 20 minutes.
Warm the beans briefly.
Serve with lemon, chilli and Parmesan.

title: Buckwheat patties with herb quark and cucumber salad
instructions: Cook buckwheat; mix with egg into patties.
Pan-fry 3 minutes per side.
Mix quark with herbs; serve with cucumber salad.

title: Turkey with chickpea puree and roast tomatoes
instructions: Halve tomatoes; roast with oil and cumin at 200 °C for 20 minutes.
Puree chickpeas with lemon and a splash of water.
Pan-fry turkey 4 minutes per side; plate with puree, tomatoes and parsley.

title: Bean and savoy cabbage stew with pearl barley
instructions: Sauté onion and carrots in the oil.
Add cabbage, beans, barley and stock; simmer 25 minutes.
Season with thyme and serve.

title: Pan-fried trout on bean and apple salad
instructions: Toss beans, diced apple and lamb's lettuce with lemon and some oil.
Pan-fry trout in remaining oil 3 minutes per side.
Serve on the salad; finish with dill.

title: Wheat berry lentil salad with orange and spinach
instructions: Cook wheat berries and lentils separately for 25 minutes; cool.
Segment the orange; toss with spinach, oil and lemon.
Fold in grains and lentils; top with walnuts.

title: Braised chicken thighs with lentils and rosemary
instructions: Brown the chicken in oil; set aside.
Sauté onion and carrots; add lentils, tomatoes and stock.
Return chicken; braise 25 minutes; finish with rosemary.

title: Barley vegetable skillet with fried egg
instructions: Cook the barley for 20 minutes.
Sauté vegetables and garlic in oil for 8 minutes; fold in barley and spinach.
Fry an egg on top and serve.

title: Edamame skillet with egg and pepper
instructions: Sauté pepper in oil for 5 minutes.
Add edamame; cook 3 minutes; add soy sauce.
Scramble in the eggs; finish with spring onion and sesame.

title: Prawn chickpea salad with pepper and lemon
instructions: Pan-fry prawns in oil for 3 minutes.
Toss chickpeas, pepper and cucumber with lemon.
Fold in prawns and parsley.

title: Green pozole with chicken and white beans
instructions: Blend tomatillos and onion; cook in oil for 5 minutes.
Simmer stock, chicken and beans for 20 minutes.
Cook kale 5 minutes more; finish with lime and coriander.

title: Oat vegetable patties with yoghurt herb dip
instructions: Grate vegetables; knead with oats, bran and egg.
Shape 4 patties; pan-fry in oil 4 minutes per side.
Mix yoghurt with parsley and serve alongside.

title: Bean tomato salad with mozzarella and basil
instructions: Combine beans and diced tomatoes.
Tear mozzarella; dress with oil and balsamic.
Scatter with basil.

title: Buckwheat salmon salad with cucumber and dill
instructions: Cook buckwheat 15 minutes; cool.
Pan-fry salmon 3 minutes per side; flake.
Toss with cucumber, lamb's lettuce, dill and lemon.

title: Lupin herb spread with vegetable sticks
instructions: Blend lupins with yoghurt, parsley, lemon and oil.
Cut vegetables into sticks.
Serve the spread with the vegetable sticks.

title: Sour cherry quark with cacao nibs
instructions: Stir the quark until smooth.
Fold in sour cherries and oat bran.
Top with cacao nibs and flaxseed.

title: Pear with fresh goat cheese and walnuts
instructions: Slice the pear; drizzle with lemon.
Plate with goat cheese and lamb's lettuce.
Scatter walnuts on top.

title: Roasted lentils with pepper
instructions: Cook lentils 18 minutes; drain; toss with oats.
Roast with pepper, oil and paprika at 200 °C for 15 minutes.
Wilt spinach briefly; finish with lemon.

title: Kidney bean dip with pepper sticks
instructions: Blend beans with yoghurt, oil, lemon, garlic and cumin.
Cut pepper into sticks.
Serve the dip with pepper sticks.

title: Lentil crackers with tomato dip
instructions: Puree cooked lentils with oats; roll flat.
Bake at 180 °C for 15 minutes until crisp; break into pieces.
Simmer tomatoes with garlic and basil; serve as dip.

title: Sugar-free apple cinnamon oat bars
instructions: Grate apple; mix with oats, bran, almonds, flax and cinnamon.
Press into a tin with the oil.
Bake at 180 °C for 25 minutes; cool and slice.

title: Peach yoghurt parfait with oat bran
instructions: Dice the peach.
Layer yoghurt and oat bran.
Top with peach, walnuts and cinnamon.

title: Vegan protein pancakes with pea protein and berries
instructions: Blend oats, pea protein, banana and soy milk into a batter.
Cook 3 pancakes in a little oil.
Serve with blueberries.

title: Soy skyr bowl with hemp seeds, berries and peanut butter
instructions: Spoon soy skyr into a bowl.
Scatter oats and hemp seeds on top.
Top with strawberries and peanut butter.

title: Smoked tofu avocado toast with hemp seeds
instructions: Toast the bread.
Mash avocado with lemon; spread on toast.
Top with sliced smoked tofu, hemp seeds and rocket.

title: Seitan breakfast patties with mushrooms
instructions: Crumble seitan; season with paprika and soy sauce.
Fry with mushrooms in oil for 8 minutes.
Serve with spring onion and tomato slices.

title: Chickpea tofu frittata
instructions: Mash tofu; mix with chickpea flour, soy milk and nutritional yeast.
Fold in spinach and tomatoes; pour into an oiled tin.
Bake at 190 °C for 25 minutes.

title: Tempeh mushroom breakfast skillet with spinach
instructions: Dice tempeh; fry in oil for 5 minutes.
Add mushrooms and garlic; cook 5 minutes more.
Wilt in spinach and tomatoes; finish with soy sauce.

title: Pea protein smoothie with mango and oats
instructions: Add all ingredients to a blender.
Blend until creamy for 60 seconds.
Serve immediately.

title: Vegan breakfast tacos with tofu and black beans
instructions: Crumble tofu; fry with beans and cumin in oil for 8 minutes.
Warm the tortillas.
Fill; top with tomato, avocado and coriander.

title: Seitan steaks with pepper oat cream and green beans
instructions: Pan-fry seitan slices 3 minutes per side.
Simmer oat cream with pepper, garlic and soy for 3 minutes.
Cook beans 6 minutes; plate with seitan and sauce.

title: Tofu chickpea curry with broccoli and rice
instructions: Cook rice; dice and fry the tofu in oil.
Simmer curry paste and coconut milk 5 minutes; add chickpeas and broccoli.
Fold in tofu and spinach; serve with rice.

title: Tempeh broccoli wok with edamame and soba
instructions: Cook soba as per pack.
Wok tempeh, broccoli and edamame with ginger and garlic for 8 minutes.
Toss with noodles and soy sauce.

title: Edamame spaghetti with tofu pesto and tomatoes
instructions: Cook pasta; add edamame for the last 3 minutes.
Blend tofu, basil, oil, yeast and garlic into pesto.
Toss everything together; serve with tomatoes.

title: Vegan lasagne with soy mince and tofu bechamel
instructions: Simmer soy mince with onion, garlic and tomatoes for 10 minutes.
Blend tofu with oat cream and nutritional yeast.
Layer; bake at 190 °C for 30 minutes.

title: Seitan kebab plate with bulgur and tahini
instructions: Cook bulgur; fry seitan strips with paprika and oil for 8 minutes.
Loosen tahini with lemon and water.
Plate with tomato, cucumber and parsley.

title: Tofu teriyaki with edamame and rice
instructions: Cook rice; dice tofu and fry crisp in sesame oil.
Reduce soy and ginger 2 minutes; coat the tofu.
Serve over rice with edamame, sesame and spring onion.

title: Tempeh burger with red cabbage slaw
instructions: Flatten tempeh; marinate in soy; fry 4 minutes per side.
Dress red cabbage with vinegar and oil.
Serve in the roll with mustard, tomato and slaw.

title: Tofu millet bowl with red cabbage and peanut dressing
instructions: Cook millet 15 minutes; dice and fry tofu in sesame oil.
Mix peanut butter with lime and soy sauce.
Assemble bowl with red cabbage, cucumber and dressing.

title: Seitan mushroom ragout with mashed potato
instructions: Cook potatoes; mash with a little oat cream.
Braise seitan and mushrooms with onion in oil for 10 minutes.
Finish with soy and thyme; serve with mash.

title: Soya chunks masala – Indian soy curry with rice
instructions: Soak soy mince in hot water 10 minutes; squeeze dry.
Sauté onion, garlic and ginger; simmer spice and tomatoes 10 minutes.
Fold in soy and spinach; serve with yoghurt and rice.

title: Tofu bulgogi with rice and kimchi
instructions: Cook rice; blend marinade from soy, pear and garlic.
Marinate tofu slices; fry in sesame oil 3 minutes per side.
Serve with rice, kimchi, sesame and spring onion.

title: Soy meatballs in tomato sauce with wholemeal spaghetti
instructions: Soak soy mince; form balls with oats and nutritional yeast.
Brown in oil; simmer with tomatoes and garlic 15 minutes.
Cook spaghetti; serve with sauce and basil.

title: Lupin schnitzel with potato salad
instructions: Blend lupins with oats and yeast; flatten and fry in oil.
Cook potatoes; dress with mustard, vinegar and spring onion.
Serve schnitzel with potato salad.

title: Edamame tofu ramen
instructions: Whisk miso into stock and heat.
Simmer noodles, edamame and pak choi for 4 minutes.
Fry tofu in sesame oil; add to bowl with nori and spring onion.

title: Seitan wok with pepper and black bean sauce
instructions: Cook rice; mash beans roughly with soy and garlic.
Wok seitan and pepper in sesame oil for 8 minutes.
Toss with sauce and ginger; serve with rice and spring onion.

title: Tofu shawarma plate with hummus and salad
instructions: Roast tofu with paprika and oil at 200 °C for 20 minutes.
Blend chickpeas with tahini and lemon into hummus.
Plate with salad and pita.

title: Beluga lentil tofu salad with edamame
instructions: Cook lentils 20 minutes; cool.
Dice and fry the tofu in oil.
Toss with edamame, rocket, lemon and spring onion.

title: Tofu vegetable quiche with chickpea flour
instructions: Blend tofu with chickpea flour, soy milk and yeast.
Quickly sauté vegetables; fold in.
Bake in a tin at 190 °C for 30 minutes.

title: Soy medallions with mushroom sauce and broccoli
instructions: Soak soy mince; shape medallions with oats and fry.
Sauté mushrooms; simmer oat cream and soy 5 minutes.
Steam broccoli; plate everything with thyme.

title: Grilled tofu with chimichurri and beans
instructions: Chop chimichurri from parsley, oil, lemon, garlic and chilli.
Grill or pan-fry tofu 3 minutes per side.
Serve with beans, pepper and chimichurri.

title: Silken tofu miso soup with edamame and soba
instructions: Heat stock; stir in miso.
Simmer soba, edamame and wakame for 4 minutes.
Cube in silken tofu; finish with spring onion and sesame oil.

title: Tempeh Reuben sandwich with sauerkraut
instructions: Flatten tempeh; season with soy and yeast; fry.
Toast bread; spread with mustard.
Fill with tempeh and sauerkraut.

title: Protein penne with pea pesto and tofu
instructions: Cook pasta; blend peas, basil, oil, lemon, protein and yeast into pesto.
Dice and quickly fry the tofu.
Toss everything together and serve.

title: Tempeh coconut curry with sweet potato
instructions: Cook rice; dice and cook sweet potato 12 minutes.
Fry tempeh; simmer curry paste and coconut milk 8 minutes.
Fold in sweet potato and spinach; serve with lime and rice.

title: Vegan soy kofte with bulgur and yoghurt dip
instructions: Soak soy mince; shape kofte with oats, onion and cumin; fry.
Cook the bulgur.
Mix soy yoghurt with parsley; serve with tomato and kofte.

title: Smoked tofu lentil stew with carrots and leek
instructions: Sauté leek and carrots in oil.
Simmer lentils, tomatoes and stock for 25 minutes.
Fold in smoked tofu cubes and thyme.

title: Chickpea salad with tofu feta, cucumber and olives
instructions: Crumble tofu; marinate with yeast, oregano and lemon.
Combine chickpeas, cucumber and olives.
Fold in tofu feta and oil.

title: Protein bars with pea protein, peanuts and oats
instructions: Knead everything into a dough.
Press into a tin; bake at 160 °C for 20 minutes.
Cool and cut into bars.

title: Edamame with tofu tahini dip
instructions: Cook edamame 5 minutes; season.
Blend tofu with tahini, lemon and garlic.
Top dip with sesame; serve with edamame.

title: Soy protein shake with cocoa and banana
instructions: Add all ingredients to a blender.
Blend until creamy for 45 seconds.
Drink immediately.

title: Roasted soybeans and pumpkin seeds with paprika
instructions: Toss soybeans and seeds with oil and paprika.
Roast at 180 °C for 10 minutes.
Serve with cucumber sticks.
