title: Egg-white omelette with mushrooms, spinach and large tomato salad
instructions: Sauté mushrooms and spinach in the oil.
Pour egg whites over; set for 4 minutes.
Dress tomato and cucumber with vinegar and basil into a large salad.

title: Watermelon skyr bowl with mint
instructions: Dice the watermelon.
Spoon skyr into a bowl; top with melon.
Finish with mint, lime and hemp seeds.

title: Miso breakfast soup with tofu, spinach and egg
instructions: Heat stock; stir in miso.
Simmer tofu and wakame for 3 minutes.
Swirl in the egg; wilt spinach; finish with spring onion.

title: Strawberry rhubarb compote with quark
instructions: Stew rhubarb and strawberries with lemon for 8 minutes.
Cool; stir in cinnamon.
Spoon over quark; top with hemp seeds.

title: Tomato zucchini egg-white scramble with crispbread
instructions: Sauté zucchini and tomato in oil for 5 minutes.
Add egg whites and scramble softly.
Serve with chives and crispbread.

title: Papaya lime quark with kiwi
instructions: Dice papaya and kiwi.
Stir quark with lime.
Top with fruit and hemp seeds.

title: Cabbage soup with chicken and tomatoes
instructions: Sauté onion and carrots in oil.
Simmer cabbage, tomatoes, stock and chicken for 25 minutes.
Finish with parsley.

title: Spaghetti squash with tomato chicken sauce
instructions: Halve squash; bake at 200 °C for 30 minutes; scrape strands.
Fry chicken and zucchini; simmer tomatoes and garlic 10 minutes.
Spoon sauce over squash; finish with basil.

title: Large chef salad with turkey, egg and yoghurt dressing
instructions: Hard-boil the egg; slice the turkey.
Put lettuce, tomato and cucumber in a large bowl.
Mix yoghurt with mustard and lemon; dress the salad.

title: Cod vegetable stew with tomatoes and fennel
instructions: Sauté fennel and zucchini in oil.
Simmer tomatoes and stock for 10 minutes.
Poach cod 6 minutes; finish with dill.

title: Chicken fennel skillet with tomatoes and cauliflower rice
instructions: Grate cauliflower; steam 5 minutes.
Pan-fry chicken and fennel in oil for 8 minutes.
Add tomatoes; serve over cauliflower rice with lemon and parsley.

title: Zucchini tomato soup with prawns
instructions: Sauté zucchini, tomato and garlic; simmer with stock 12 minutes.
Blend the soup roughly.
Poach prawns 3 minutes; finish with basil.

title: Broccoli spinach soup with cottage cheese
instructions: Sauté onion; simmer broccoli and stock 12 minutes.
Wilt in spinach; blend.
Serve with cottage cheese and lemon.

title: Turkey breast with sheet-pan vegetables and yoghurt dip
instructions: Roast vegetables with oil on a tray at 200 °C for 25 minutes.
Pan-fry turkey 4 minutes per side.
Mix yoghurt with herbs and lemon; serve alongside.

title: Shirataki vegetable wok with prawns
instructions: Rinse shirataki; boil 2 minutes.
Wok vegetables and prawns with ginger in sesame oil for 6 minutes.
Toss with noodles and soy sauce.

title: Pollock tomato zucchini skillet with basil
instructions: Sauté zucchini and garlic in oil.
Add tomatoes; simmer 5 minutes; poach pollock 6 minutes.
Finish with basil and lemon.

title: Tomato pepper soup with beans and chicken
instructions: Sauté pepper; simmer tomatoes and stock 12 minutes.
Blend; simmer beans and diced chicken 8 minutes.
Finish with basil.

title: Cucumber radish salad with tofu and sesame
instructions: Slice cucumber and radish thinly.
Dice tofu; fry in sesame oil.
Dress with soy, vinegar, sesame and spring onion.

title: Pointed cabbage turkey stew with caraway
instructions: Brown turkey and carrots in oil.
Braise cabbage with stock and caraway for 20 minutes.
Finish with yoghurt.

title: Hot and sour soup with tofu and mushrooms
instructions: Simmer stock with mushrooms, bamboo, soy and chilli for 8 minutes.
Add tofu; swirl in egg white.
Finish with vinegar, sesame oil and spring onion.

title: Pumpkin zucchini goulash with turkey
instructions: Brown turkey and onion in oil.
Braise pumpkin, zucchini, tomatoes and paprika for 20 minutes.
Season and serve.

title: Autumn salad with chicken, pear, red cabbage and walnuts
instructions: Pan-fry chicken 4 minutes per side; slice.
Combine red cabbage, pear and lamb's lettuce.
Dress with vinegar, oil and walnuts; top with chicken.

title: Savoy cabbage carrot stew with chicken
instructions: Brown the chicken in oil.
Braise cabbage, carrots and stock for 20 minutes.
Finish with thyme.

title: Tomato soup with chicken meatballs
instructions: Mince chicken; form meatballs with oats.
Simmer tomatoes, zucchini and stock 10 minutes.
Poach meatballs 8 minutes; finish with basil.

title: Beef vegetable skillet with pepper and sugar snaps
instructions: Slice beef; sear in oil; set aside.
Stir-fry vegetables and ginger for 6 minutes.
Return beef with soy sauce.

title: Chinese cabbage salad with prawns and mandarins
instructions: Pan-fry prawns in sesame oil for 3 minutes.
Combine Chinese cabbage and mandarin.
Dress with vinegar, sesame and spring onion; top with prawns.

title: Ratatouille soup with white beans
instructions: Sauté vegetables in oil for 8 minutes.
Simmer stock and beans for 15 minutes.
Finish with basil.

title: Boiled beef soup with vegetables
instructions: Simmer beef in stock for 30 minutes.
Add vegetables; cook 15 minutes more.
Slice the beef; serve in the soup with parsley.

title: Chłodnik – cold beetroot soup with egg
instructions: Cook and grate beetroot; mix with stock and yoghurt; chill.
Hard-boil egg; dice cucumber and radishes.
Assemble; finish with dill and lemon.

title: Hake in a vegetable parcel with lemon and dill
instructions: Lay vegetables on baking paper; place fish on top.
Drizzle with oil, lemon and dill; seal the parcel.
Bake at 200 °C for 20 minutes.

title: Green bean tomato skillet with chicken and feta
instructions: Brown chicken in oil; set aside.
Braise beans and tomatoes for 12 minutes.
Return chicken; top with feta and oregano.

title: Zucchini tomato stew with lentils and basil
instructions: Sauté garlic; add zucchini and tomatoes.
Simmer lentils and stock for 20 minutes.
Finish with basil.

title: Cucumber melon salad with prawns and mint
instructions: Pan-fry prawns in oil for 3 minutes.
Dice cucumber and melon.
Dress with lime and mint; top with prawns.

title: Pan-fried tofu with zucchini and carrot noodles
instructions: Spiralize zucchini and carrots into noodles.
Fry tofu crisp in sesame oil.
Wok vegetable noodles and ginger 3 minutes; finish with soy and sesame.

title: Cucumber kohlrabi salad with skyr dill dressing
instructions: Cut cucumber and kohlrabi into matchsticks.
Mix skyr with dill and lemon.
Toss the salad with the dressing.

title: Tomato salad with light mozzarella and rocket
instructions: Slice tomatoes and mozzarella.
Arrange with rocket.
Drizzle with oil, balsamic and basil.

title: Roasted cauliflower florets with pepper and yoghurt dip
instructions: Roast cauliflower and pepper with oil and cumin at 200 °C for 20 minutes.
Mix yoghurt with lemon and parsley.
Serve with cucumber sticks and the dip.

title: Red cabbage apple salad with yoghurt and pumpkin seeds
instructions: Finely slice red cabbage and apple.
Fold in yoghurt and vinegar.
Top with pumpkin seeds.

title: Kiwi melon salad with cottage cheese
instructions: Dice kiwi and melon.
Plate with cottage cheese.
Finish with mint and lime.

title: Strawberry skyr cold bowl
instructions: Blend half the strawberries; stir into skyr.
Top with remaining strawberries.
Finish with mint, lime and hemp seeds.
